title: Sales Marketing Executive
description:
**Company:**
Trioworkz Technologies Private Limited

**Product:**
Imeegi – Digital Signage & Advertising Platform

**Job Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
Freshers to 2 years

**Qualification:**
BBA, MBA, B.Com, or any equivalent degree

**Work Mode:**
Field Sales

**Location:**
Chennai

**Department:**
Sales & Marketing

About Imeegi

Imeegi is a digital signage and advertising platform that enables businesses to advertise on digital screens installed in apartments, malls, food courts, commercial establishments, and other high-footfall locations.

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Sales & Marketing Executive to acquire advertisers, build business relationships, and grow advertising revenue for Imeegi.

Roles & Responsibilities

**1. Advertiser Acquisition & Sales**

* Identify and approach potential advertisers, including restaurants, retail stores, supermarkets, gyms, clinics, salons, educational institutions, real estate companies, and other local businesses.
* Conduct field visits to meet business owners, marketing managers, and decision-makers.
* Explain Imeegi's advertising solutions, screen locations, audience reach, campaign options, and pricing.
* Understand customer advertising requirements and recommend suitable advertising packages based on their target audience and budget.
* Generate leads, conduct sales pitches, negotiate pricing within approved limits, and convert prospects into paying advertisers.
* Achieve monthly targets for advertiser acquisition and advertising revenue.

**2. Field Marketing & Lead Generation**

* Identify potential business clusters, commercial areas, and markets where Imeegi's advertising services can be promoted.
* Conduct door-to-door business visits and proactively generate new sales leads.
* Distribute marketing materials, share advertising proposals, and demonstrate the Imeegi platform to prospective customers.
* Explore opportunities for seasonal promotions, festival campaigns, new store launches, and local business advertising.
* Build a pipeline of prospective advertisers for continuous revenue generation.

**3. Advertising Campaign Coordination**

* Collect campaign requirements, advertisement creatives, logos, videos, and other required materials from customers.
* Coordinate with the internal team to ensure advertisements meet Imeegi's creative specifications and are approved before publishing.
* Follow up with customers for campaign confirmation, payments, renewals, and repeat advertising bookings.
* Keep customers informed about campaign schedules, screen locations, and campaign completion.

**4. Business Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing advertisers to encourage repeat business and referrals.
* Regularly follow up with prospects and existing customers to identify additional advertising opportunities.
* Maintain a database of leads, customer interactions, proposals, sales conversions, and follow-up activities.
* Collect customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve Imeegi's advertising services.

**5. Market Research & Reporting**

* Research competitors, advertising rates, customer preferences, and local market opportunities.
* Identify new business segments and industries that could benefit from digital screen advertising.
* Submit daily activity reports and periodic sales performance updates to the reporting manager.
* Provide feedback on market demand, pricing, customer objections, and competitor offerings.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Good verbal communication and convincing skills.
* Interest in sales, marketing, business development, and customer acquisition.
* Willingness to travel and meet customers as part of daily fieldwork.
* Confidence in approaching business owners and presenting advertising solutions.
* Basic computer skills and familiarity with email, spreadsheets, and WhatsApp Business.
* Ability to follow up consistently, work independently, and achieve sales targets.
* A positive attitude, willingness to learn, and a strong focus on results.

Eligibility

* Freshers and candidates with up to 2 years of experience in sales, marketing, business development, or field sales are welcome.
* BBA, MBA, B.Com, or any equivalent qualification.
* Candidates with prior experience in advertising sales, media sales, digital marketing, or B2B field sales will have an advantage.
* A two-wheeler and valid driving licence are preferred for field visits.

Compensation & Benefits

* Salary based on qualifications and experience.
* Fuel allowance for approved business-related field travel.
* Performance-based incentives linked to advertiser acquisition and revenue targets.
* Opportunity to grow with an emerging digital advertising and technology platform.

What Success Looks Like

* Consistently acquiring new paying advertisers.
* Meeting monthly advertising revenue and sales targets.
* Building a strong pipeline of prospective customers.
* Generating repeat business and renewals from existing advertisers.
* Expanding Imeegi's presence among local businesses and advertisers.
* **Interested candidates can apply with their resume.**

title: Search Marketing Specialist
description:
**Paid Marketing Specialist**

**Department:**
Marketing

**Location:**
Chennai

**Company:**
Navia Markets Ltd (navia.co.in) — SEBI-registered stock brokerage (INZ000095034)

**About Navia**

Navia Markets Ltd is a SEBI-registered stock brokerage with over 30 years of legacy, headquartered in Chennai. As we scale client acquisition, we're building out a focused paid acquisition function — and we're looking for a hands-on leader to own strategy, execution, and performance across every paid channel.

**Role Overview**

The Paid Marketing Specialist will own Navia's entire paid acquisition function — strategy, budgeting, creative direction, campaign execution, and performance analysis across Google, Meta, YouTube, and Email. This is a dual-mandate role spanning two closely linked areas:

* Creatives & Campaigns (Track A): Planning, briefing, and launching high-performing ad campaigns and creatives across Google Search/Display/PMax, Meta, YouTube, and Email.
* Data Analysis & Optimization (Track B): Owning performance tracking, budget allocation, attribution, and continuous testing to improve CAC, conversion, and ROAS.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Own the paid acquisition roadmap and budget across Google, Meta, YouTube, and Email
* Set channel-level and campaign-level targets (CAC, CPL, ROAS, conversion rate) and track against them
* Manage and mentor the paid acquisition team, including the Growth Marketing Executive
* Report spend efficiency, performance trends, and roadmap updates to the AVP Marketing and senior stakeholders

**Track A — Creatives & Campaigns**

* Plan, brief, and launch campaigns across Google (Search, Display, PMax, YouTube) and Meta (Facebook, Instagram)
* Direct creative development — ad copy, static/video creatives, and landing pages — in collaboration with design and content teams
* Own Email campaign strategy for acquisition and re-engagement, including segmentation and creative testing
* Manage always-on and seasonal/defensive campaigns (e.g., brand keyword bidding, competitive conquesting)
* Ensure creative and messaging compliance with SEBI/regulatory advertising guidelines for financial services

**Track B — Data Analysis & Optimization**

* Own end-to-end performance tracking and attribution across all paid channels
* Analyze CRM and conversion funnel data to optimize budget allocation across channels, days, and audiences
* Run structured A/B tests on creatives, audiences, and bidding strategies
* Build and maintain performance dashboards and present data-backed recommendations to leadership
* Partner with the organic growth team to ensure consistent measurement (GSC/GA4) and avoid channel overlap

**Requirements**

* 3–6 years of experience in paid media/performance marketing, with hands-on ownership of Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager
* Experience in Automating Paid Marketing (Track A) and Analysis (Track B) using AI
* Proven experience managing meaningful monthly ad budgets with clear CAC/ROAS accountability
* Strong creative sensibility — comfortable briefing and evaluating ad creatives, not just running campaigns
* Advanced proficiency with GA4, conversion tracking, and attribution/reporting tools
* Experience with Email marketing platforms for acquisition or lifecycle campaigns
* Experience managing or mentoring a small team
* Strong analytical skills — comfortable working directly with campaign and CRM data to drive decisions
* Prior experience in fintech, BFSI, or stock broking is a strong plus
* Familiarity with regulatory/compliance considerations for financial services advertising is a plus

**What Success Looks Like**

* Increase in Number of account openings and Activations
* Consistent improvement in CAC and ROAS across all paid channels quarter-over-quarter
* Efficient, data-backed budget allocation across Google, Meta, YouTube, and Email
* A steady pipeline of high-performing, well-tested creatives
* Clear, reliable performance reporting to leadership
* A well-run team with clear ownership and consistently met targets

title: Social Media Design Intern
description:
**About the role**

You will be the person who turns Acrophase's ideas, work and people into short, scroll-stopping video. Most of your week will go into shooting and editing reels and shorts, with the rest spent planning, publishing and tracking posts on Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube and other channels we use.

This is a hands-on junior role. You will work closely with the marketing team, learn our brand voice, and grow into owning the social calendar end to end.

**Key responsibilities****Video editing (primary)**

* Edit short-form and long-form video: cuts, pacing, transitions, colour correction, sound clean-up and music.
* Add captions, subtitles, motion text and simple graphics that match Acrophase's brand style.
* Adapt one piece of footage into versions for each platform (9:16, 1:1, 16:9) and its length limits.
* Keep raw footage, project files and final exports organised and easy to find.

**Reels and short-form content**

* Plan, script and shoot reels, often on a phone, including behind-the-scenes, team, product and educational content.
* Track trending audio, formats and hooks, and adapt the ones that suit our brand.
* Deliver an agreed number of reels each week to a consistent quality.

**Social media management**

* Build and maintain a monthly content calendar across Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook and X.
* Write captions and hashtags, and schedule posts using platform tools or a scheduler such as Meta Business Suite or Buffer.
* Reply to comments and messages promptly, and flag anything sensitive to your lead.
* Track reach, engagement, watch time and follower growth, and share a short monthly report with what worked.

**Required skills and qualifications**

* Strong, hands-on video editing in at least one of Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut.
* A portfolio of reels or short videos you have edited yourself (Instagram, YouTube or a drive link).
* A good eye for pacing, framing and hooks that hold attention in the first 3 seconds.
* Working knowledge of Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube, including how their formats and algorithms differ.
* Clear written English for captions.
* Comfort shooting on a smartphone, with basic lighting and audio know-how.
* Ability to manage deadlines, take feedback and turn around revisions quickly.
* A degree or diploma in media, visual communication, marketing or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to have**

* Design skills in Canva, Photoshop or Figma for thumbnails, carousels and static posts.
* Experience with Meta Ads or boosting posts.
* Familiarity with analytics tools such as Meta Insights, YouTube Studio or LinkedIn Analytics.
* Basic photography skills.

**Probation: your first 90 days**

The role starts with a 3-month probation. At the end, we review your work together and confirm the role on successful completion. Here is what success looks like along the way:

**Period**

**What we expect**

Month 1

Learn the brand, tools and audience; edit and publish your first reels with guidance.

Month 2

Deliver reels on schedule with fewer revisions; run the content calendar for at least one platform.

Month 3

Manage posting across all platforms; share a monthly performance report with ideas for improvement.

We will hold a short check-in at the end of each month so there are no surprises at the final review.

**What we offer and how to apply**

* Real ownership of a brand's social presence early in your career.
* Room to experiment with new formats and ideas.
* A clear path to a confirmed role after probation.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a high-performance Sales & Key Account Manager to generate new business, close high-value digital marketing retainers, and grow strategic client accounts.

This is a
**hunter + farmer role**
where you'll own the journey from prospecting and qualification to pitching, negotiation, closing, retention, and account growth. You'll work closely with Performance Marketing, Content, Creative, and Strategy teams to understand client needs and sell the right digital marketing solutions.

**What You'll Do**

* Build and manage a self-generated pipeline of prospective clients across relevant industries, company sizes, marketing spends, and business potential

* Conduct regular account reviews and understand client business objectives beyond individual campaigns.

* Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling across performance marketing, content, creative, additional campaigns, and new digital channels.

* Identify churn risks early and work with internal delivery teams to address client expectations and support renewals.

* Work closely with Performance Marketing, Content, Creative, and Strategy teams to coordinate client requirements and deliver the right solutions.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

We are looking for a high-performance Sales & Key Account Manager responsible for generating new business, closing high-value digital marketing retainers, and growing strategic client accounts.

The person will be expected to:

Prospect → Qualify → Pitch → Propose → Negotiate → Close → Retain → Upsell The agency will provide digital marketing expertise and delivery support, but lead generation and business development will primarily be the responsibility of the Sales & Key Account Manager.

**₹20-40 Lakhs/month**
retainer

**₹4 Lakhs/month**

The long-term objective is to build and maintain approximately 10-20 clients at the average retainer level, while continuously replacing churn and increasing revenue through upselling and cross-selling.

**Must-Have**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.

* 3–7 years of experience in B2B sales, digital marketing, advertising, media, professional services, or agency sales.

* Proven experience in selling services rather than only products.

* Strong understanding of digital marketing.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

* Strong presentation, negotiation, follow-up, and closing skills.

* Ability to engage with business owners, CMOs, Marketing Heads, and other senior decision-makers.

* Comfortable working with revenue targets and managing multiple client accounts.

* Experience using CRM tools and sales reporting systems.

**Good to Have**

* MBA/PGDM in Sales or Marketing.

* Existing network of business owners or marketing professionals.

* Experience selling digital marketing retainers.

* Experience with performance marketing or lead-generation services.

* Experience managing high-value accounts.

* Experience working in a digital agency environment.

**Success in This Role**

* Consistently achieve monthly and quarterly new business revenue targets.

* Build a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities and convert them into new clients.

* Improve average deal value and generate strong gross margin.

* Grow existing strategic accounts through upselling and cross-selling.

* Maintain strong client retention and renewal rates.

* Maintain accurate CRM records, follow-up discipline, pipeline coverage, and revenue forecasts.

* Build and maintain approximately 10–20 clients at the target average retainer level while continuously replacing churn and increasing account revenue.

**Why MassCampaigns?**

**Welcome to the Average Kootam**
— A place where you’re trusted to own your work, make decisions, learn from the experience, and keep moving forward. You’ll know what you’re working towards, have the freedom to grow into bigger responsibilities, and see the impact of what you do. Teams here don’t work in isolation Sales, Marketing, Design, Engineering, and others work closely, challenge ideas, and build better things together. And when we’re not building, we make time to learn, connect, have fun, and bring the whole Kootam together.

title: Chief Marketing Officer
description:
**About Amadora**

Since 2011, Amadora has made ice cream the hard way: from scratch, in small batches, with real ingredients and no premixes. What started as a single Chennai parlour is now a premium artisanal brand with 21 stores across Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad and Cochin by the end of this year, and 20 more planned for 2027. Our range has grown beyond scoops into ice cream bars, cakes, sandwiches, chocolate bars, baked goods and high-protein ice creams, and we’re preparing to enter organised retail.

We’re a franchise-led business with a loyal following and a product people rave about. Now we need someone to build the brand that matches it.

**The Role**

You’ll be Amadora’s first CMO, reporting directly to the Founder & MD. You’ll own the brand, customer growth and marketing across stores, delivery apps and new retail channels, and you’ll build the team to do it.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own brand strategy, positioning and identity across every touchpoint, from store and packaging to social and retail shelf
* Drive same-store sales growth through local store marketing, seasonal campaigns and new launches
* Plan and execute launch playbooks for new cities and franchise openings
* Grow Swiggy and Zomato performance, including listings, offers, ratings and visibility
* Build Amadora’s digital presence: social, content, influencers, performance marketing and CRM/loyalty
* Lead the go-to-market for organised retail and new formats (bars, chocolate, cakes, high-protein range)
* Support franchise development with brand material that helps attract the right partners
* Manage agencies and build an in-house marketing team
* Own the marketing budget and report on ROI with clear metrics

**What You Bring**

* 10+ years in marketing, with senior leadership experience in F&B, QSR, food retail or premium consumer brands
* A track record of building a brand people love, not just running campaigns
* Hands-on experience with multi-location retail or franchise marketing
* Strong command of digital, performance marketing and delivery-platform growth
* Experience launching products into modern trade or organised retail is a strong plus
* Comfort with a founder-led, fast-moving company where you’ll build as much as you manage
* Someone who spends time in stores, talks to customers and tastes the product

**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)**

* A clear brand strategy and identity guide rolled out consistently across all stores, packaging and digital channels
* Measurable same-store sales growth in existing stores, driven by planned campaigns and local store marketing
* A repeatable launch playbook used for every new store opening in 2027
* Higher delivery-app ratings, visibility and online revenue share across Swiggy and Zomato
* A successful brand launch into organised retail, with marketing support for new product lines
* An in-house marketing team and agency setup in place, with monthly reporting on spend and return

**Why Join**

* Build the brand of one of South India’s best-loved artisanal ice cream companies at a key growth stage
* Direct line to the founder and a real seat at the leadership table
* A product you’ll be proud to market

title: Digital Marketing and Enquiry Executive
description:
About us

We help students from India plan and complete their study-abroad journey, and we represent universities and colleges in South and South East Asia. [Planet Education Chennai / Nexus Vantage Holdings]

About the role

You will run the ads that bring students in, make the creatives, and call every new enquiry to find the genuine prospects. You see both ends of the funnel, so you can tell us which ad, creative and message brings students worth counselling.

What you will do

Ads and creatives

Set up and schedule Meta ad campaigns from approved briefs

Build ad creatives in Canva from our templates, with variants for testing

Check spend, leads and cost per lead every day, and flag anything off

Tag every campaign lead to its source, so we can trace results from ad to enrolment

Calls and leads

Call every new student lead within the agreed response time

Qualify each lead on course and destination, budget, English level, intake timing and seriousness

Update the CRM the same day with a dated note and the right stage

Pass qualified students to our counsellors with a clear summary, and follow up with those not yet ready

Reporting

Send a short weekly report: leads, qualified leads, drop-offs, cost per qualified lead by campaign, and what to test next

What we are looking for

You like numbers and creative work, and you are comfortable on the phone.

1 to 2 years in digital ads, social media, telecalling, lead qualification or study-abroad counselling (strong freshers with a good portfolio are welcome)

Canva skills, with samples of creatives you have made

Working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, or a willingness to learn fast

Clear, friendly communication in English and Tamil (other Indian languages are a plus)

Comfort with a CRM and careful record-keeping

How we measure success

Speed of first response, share of leads qualified, cost per qualified lead by campaign, accurate CRM notes and campaign tags, and creatives delivered on time.

Working pattern

Office-based in Chennai, Monday to Saturday, 10:30 am to 6 pm.

Hiring process

A screening call, two short work tests (one creative, one call exercise), then a paid trial week.

How to apply

* Send your CV, two or three samples of your creatives, and a short note on why you want this role to [contact email]. You can also apply through LinkedIn.

Creative concepts

title: Marketing Ops -Operations AVP
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Customer**
The Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper, more valuable relationships with customers by combining business strategy, creativity, data, technology, GenAI, and scaled operations. We help Deloitte client service teams drive customer value creation and sustained growth across customer and commercial strategy, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. Our multidisciplinary teams—strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects—bridge strategy and execution. Through Business Process as a Service (BPaaS), we also design, transition, and run technology-enabled operations that improve performance today while generating the data, insight, and learning required for continuous transformation.
  
  
**Level: Associate Vice President – Marketing Operations & BPaaS**
**Work you’ll do**
The AVP – Marketing Operations & BPaaS will define the strategic direction and lead the build-out of an integrated agency and marketing operations capability for enterprise clients. The role combines deep marketing domain expertise with large-scale operations leadership, commercial ownership, digital transformation, and AI-enabled innovation.
  
  
This leader will set the agenda across the portfolio—translating CMO priorities and market shifts into differentiated services; establishing repeatable operating models; steering complex transitions and multi-account delivery; and sponsoring automation and AI initiatives from opportunity identification through production deployment and benefits realization.
  
  
The VP will provide clear direction to capability, solutioning, transition, delivery, technology, and innovation leaders, while remaining close enough to the operation to challenge decisions, remove barriers, and protect quality. Success requires a leader who can move fluently between executive strategy and the operational detail of how marketing work is planned, produced, activated, measured, and optimized.
  
  
**LEADERSHIP MANDATE**
Set direction
  
  

* Scale operations
* Industrialize AI

**Job Responsibilities**
**Strategy, Thought Leadership & Growth**

* Set the strategic agenda and market point of view: Define positioning, growth priorities, the multi-year roadmap, and investment agenda; advise senior executives and lead market-facing thought leadership.
* Productize and grow the business: Build modular offerings, reference operating models, accelerators, commercial constructs, and go-to-market plans; shape complex opportunities and own pipeline, bookings, revenue, margin, and investment.
* Build executive and ecosystem relationships: Serve as a trusted adviser to client and Deloitte leaders and mobilize alliances and specialist partners around priority propositions and outcomes.
* Build market credibility: Lead thought leadership, executive forums, alliance narratives, case studies, and market-facing points of view that establish a differentiated position in marketing operations and managed services.

Marketing Operations & Enterprise Scale
  
  

* Provide end-to-end domain direction: Challenge the design and performance of operations across marketing demand and workflow, campaigns and media, CRM and personalization, creative and content supply chain, MarTech platforms, data, analytics, and measurement.
* Design the operating system: Define roles, handoffs, service boundaries, playbooks, controls, governance, and measures across retained marketing teams, agencies, technology partners, and global delivery.
* Build and scale enterprise operations: Set up, transition, stabilize, and expand multi-account, multi-tower operations supporting 300–1,000+ practitioners; standardize and reuse while protecting brand, creative, customer, market, and regulatory context.
* Scale operational delivery: Set priorities and govern service quality, capacity, risk, financial health, resilience, and continuous transformation; act as the senior escalation point when outcomes are at risk.

**AI-Enabled Transformation & Performance**

* Set a value-led AI and automation agenda: Prioritize analytics, automation, GenAI, and agentic use cases across intake, workflow, content, quality assurance, campaign operations, reporting, optimization, and knowledge management.
* Scale innovation into live operations: Sponsor initiatives from business case through production, adoption, and benefits realization; redesign processes, roles, skills, controls, KPIs, staffing, and commercial assumptions as work changes.
* Govern trust and performance: Establish responsible AI, data, privacy, security, intellectual property, and human-oversight guardrails, with scorecards covering marketing outcomes, SLAs, quality, productivity, innovation, financials, and risk.

**Enterprise & Talent Leadership**

* Lead through leaders: Build the organization and leadership system, clarify accountabilities, align multidisciplinary teams, coach senior leaders, and create succession depth.
* Build a differentiated talent model: Combine marketing craft, platform expertise, operational rigor, consulting capability, and AI fluency; mobilize consulting, creative, media, technology, data, finance, risk, talent, and alliance teams around a shared direction.

**Location:**
Hyderabad / Chennai
  
  
**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree required; postgraduate qualification or MBA preferred.
  
  
**Experience**

* Senior leadership experience: 16+ years of professional experience, including at least 10 years leading large-scale marketing operations, agency delivery, digital operations, or managed services and a minimum of 5 years in executive leadership roles.
* Proven build-and-scale track record: Demonstrated experience setting up, transitioning, stabilizing, and scaling global or enterprise operations, including organizations of approximately 300–1,000+ team members.
* Deep marketing operations credibility: Strong operational understanding across multiple marketing domains such as campaign and media operations, CRM and lifecycle marketing, creative and content supply chain, MarTech operations, customer journey orchestration, data, analytics, and measurement.
* AI and automation leadership: Evidence of identifying, sponsoring, and scaling automation, analytics, GenAI, or agentic initiatives within live operations, with responsibility for adoption, controls, operating-model change, and measurable benefits—not only pilots or technology implementation.
* Commercial and P&L ownership: Experience owning a multi-million-dollar portfolio or P&L and making decisions across growth, pricing, investment, margin, capacity, utilization, and risk.
* Global delivery and transformation: Experience leading distributed onshore, nearshore, and offshore models and large transformation programs across multiple clients, geographies, or service towers.
* Executive client leadership: Credibility with senior marketing, customer, digital, technology, operations, and procurement stakeholders and the ability to influence strategic decisions in complex client environments.
* Thought leadership and market orientation: A clear point of view on the evolution of marketing operations, agency models, platforms, data, AI, and managed services, with the ability to convert that perspective into propositions and client conversations.
* Leadership judgment: Strong analytical, commercial, organizational, negotiation, and influencing skills, with the ability to make timely decisions, manage ambiguity, and provide calm direction during high-stakes delivery situations.

**The team**
Our Digital Foundry Operate & Innovations (DFO&I) team helps organizations design, build, transition, and scale digital products, experiences, and operations that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, data specialists, and operators, we connect the work of transformation with the discipline of ongoing operations. Our capabilities span the digital lifecycle from research, experience and platform design through content production, marketing automation, campaign operations, and continuous optimization—enabling clients to experiment, learn, and scale with confidence.

* Operating excellence and transformation methods: Experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, process intelligence, service management, Agile, product management, or equivalent methods to redesign and improve live operations.

title: Senior Marketing Manager
description:
**About the job**

Complyance is a fast-growing e-invoicing and tax compliance SaaS company. Through a single API, we help businesses meet e-invoicing mandates across markets, including the UAE and Saudi Arabia’s ZATCA requirements, without rebuilding their finance systems every time a regulation changes.

With a strong and growing MENA footprint, we work with finance and tax teams who need compliance to be reliable, fast and invisible. Our platform is live across 10+ jurisdictions, we have built a strong base in MENA and India, and we are now expanding into Europe and the US.

**Life at Complyance:**

We are building a lean, high-ownership team that cares about doing the basics exceptionally well. Our work is visible, our decisions matter, and we are looking for people who want to shape how a company grows, not just keep it running.

**The mission:**

Pipeline comes first. As Marketing Manager, you will own and drive our demand generation and growth engine across MENA, while giving strategic direction to content and brand.

This is a hands-on, strategic role for someone who can think across the whole marketing function. You will be part of the founding go-to-market leadership team, working closely with the VP – Growth, sales leadership and the founders. You will own a dedicated marketing budget, lead a small existing team, and bring in freelancers and partners where it makes sense.

**Where you’ll leave your mark:**

**•**
**Build the pipeline engine:**

 Own pipeline generation across MENA and work closely with sales leadership to hit qualified pipeline and revenue targets.

**•**
**Run multi-channel growth programmes:**

 Build and run demand generation across paid, organic, email, events, partnerships and product-led motions.

**•**
**Let the data decide where to invest:**

 Define and track the marketing funnel, including conversion rates, CAC and pipeline contribution by channel.

**•**
**Open up new segments:**

 Identify and prioritise target segments and verticals across MENA, starting with the UAE and Saudi e-invoicing mandates, extend those playbooks to adjacent markets, and partner with sales on account-based marketing for enterprise and mid-market accounts.

**•**
**Set the content direction:**

 Own content strategy and editorial direction across the funnel, from top-of-funnel education to mid-funnel nurture and bottom-funnel sales enablement. You will direct a small content team and freelancers, leading and shaping content rather than writing it day to day, and make sure it speaks credibly to finance and tax audiences.

**•**
**Be the strategic marketing voice:**

 Shape how Complyance positions itself as we scale, own brand consistency and market positioning across MENA and India, and represent marketing in cross-functional planning with Sales, Product and the VP – Growth.

**•**
**Own the budget and the team:**

 Be accountable for spend efficiency and ROI across channels, lead and develop the existing team, manage freelancers and agencies, and work with a modern marketing technology stack covering automation, CRM and paid and organic channels.

**The kind of leader we’re looking for**

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

**•**

Have 7+ years of marketing experience (10+ preferred), with real ownership of demand generation and growth outcomes, not just execution.

**•**

Have proven experience marketing a SaaS or subscription business, and are comfortable with SaaS metrics such as MRR/ARR, CAC, pipeline velocity and funnel conversion.

**•**

Come from tax-tech, compliance, advisory or another regulated B2B SaaS category (strongly preferred), and can credibly market a compliance and e-invoicing proposition to finance and tax buyers.

**•**

Have hands-on exposure to the MENA market (UAE and Saudi Arabia preferred), including regional buyer behaviour, channels and go-to-market nuances.

**•**

Have experience directing content resources, teams or freelancers.

**•**

Are a strategic thinker who is comfortable with autonomy in a lean, fast-scaling startup, and can move between hands-on execution and big-picture planning.

**•**

Bring strong stakeholder management and the confidence to work directly with sales leadership and founders.

If you have 7–9 years of experience, we would want to see scope and impact that match a strategic, largely autonomous mandate.

**Bonus points :**

**•**

Experience marketing specifically into finance, tax or audit functions.

**•**

Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) motions.

**•**

Experience as part of a founding or early go-to-market team at a startup.

**What success looks like in your first 6–12 months**

**•**

A working demand generation engine with clear, channel-by-channel pipeline contribution and improving conversion rates.

**•**

A content function that is strategically directed and consistently supports the funnel, even when largely executed by others.

**•**

Stronger brand credibility and sharper market positioning for Complyance across MENA.

**•**

You are a trusted strategic partner to the VP – Growth and sales leadership on go-to-market decisions.

**Why Complyance?**

**•**

Competitive base salary plus a performance-linked variable component tied to pipeline and growth targets. The range will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

**•**

A seat on the founding go-to-market leadership team, with real ownership of budget, strategy and outcomes.

**•**

The chance to build marketing for a category that is being shaped by regulation right now, across some of the fastest-moving e-invoicing markets in the world.

**•**

Comprehensive benefits, including health insurance for you and your family, paid time off and relocation support as required.

**•**

A lean, collaborative team where your work is visible and your decisions matter.

**How to apply**

* Apply on LinkedIn with your CV, or share the profile of someone you think is a strong fit.

title: Supv-Solutions Archt
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**
**Type of Work:**
Strategic leadership, executive technical sponsorship, and cross-functional management. The daily focus is on leading a team of technical experts, overseeing overarching architectural strategies—spanning traditional underlay networks (MPLS, Dedicated Internet, Broadband), modern overlays (SD-WAN, SASE), Private 5G ecosystems, and advanced VoIP modernization efforts—and removing roadblocks to drive multi-million-dollar deals from discovery to closing.
  
  
**Expected Volumes:**
Managing a high-performing team of Solution Architects who are concurrently handling multiple enterprise-level deal cycles and automation projects. You will navigate a highly matrixed environment, managing executive-level relationships with internal teams, external OEM partners, and C-level customer stakeholders.
  
  
**Risk & Criticality:**
You are accountable for the foundational telecom, cloud, security, voice, and wireless enterprise infrastructure designed by your team. Failure to properly allocate resources, vet architectural designs, or align OEM vendors and implementation teams can stall major revenue opportunities. Poor oversight can lead to deployment failures, SLA breaches, or lost enterprise contracts.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For...**

* Team Leadership & Mentorship: Hire, coach, and manage a team of Pre-Sales Solution Architects. Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Executive Deal Sponsorship: Act as the executive technical sponsor and escalation point for high-stakes enterprise deals. Step in to navigate complex multi-vendor negotiations (including UCaaS/CPaaS and networking OEMs) and drive alignment between Sales, Product Management, and Implementation teams.
* Architectural Oversight & Legacy Modernization: Maintain accountability for the team's designs. Steer overarching strategies to transition legacy enterprise accounts from physical PRI/TDM and global MPLS networks to resilient, cloud-hosted SIP architectures and internet-first (DIA/Broadband) SD-WAN/SASE overlays.
* Strategic Alignment & 5G GTM: Partner with Sales Leadership to define technical Go-To-Market strategies for cutting-edge Private 5G and Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) solutions, ensuring the right mix of RAN, Core, and IP architects are allocated.
* Deal & Technical Escalation: Serve as the executive point of escalation for complex pre-sales roadblocks. Step in to unblock stalled architectural disagreements with internal Product teams, and smooth out critical handoff friction between Pre-Sales and Implementation teams.
* Architectural & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure the team’s solution designs strictly adhere to internal standards, delivery capabilities, and regional telecom regulatory requirements (e.g., data sovereignty, local VoIP routing laws) prior to contract signature.
* Strategic Product Advocacy: Aggregate field feedback—such as gaps in global broadband footprints, MPLS offloading challenges, or specific 5G network slicing requests—to act as the primary voice of the customer to VP-level Product Management.
* AI/Automation Acumen: Sponsor and integrate LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) to drive internal team efficiencies and streamline complex sales engineering workflows.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Telecom/IT/Communications or a relevant engineering field.
* 9+ years of relevant work experience in the telecom or tech industry, with 3+ years of experience directly managing, mentoring, or leading technical pre-sales teams.
* Comprehensive Core Networking: Deep architectural understanding of traditional and modern WAN solutions, including global MPLS, Dedicated Internet Access (DIA), high-availability Broadband aggregation, and Software Defined Networking (SDN/SD-WAN).
* Advanced Wireless & 5G: Strong knowledge of cellular networks, LTE, Private 5G, and IoT ecosystems.
* Voice/UC Expertise: Strong understanding of overarching VoIP architectures, Session Border Controllers (SBCs), SIP trunking, and contact center modernization paths.
* Cloud Computing Expertise: Proven experience overseeing the design and integration of telecom solutions within public, private, or hybrid cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Proven ability to orchestrate complex technical workflows across a matrixed organization, driving executive alignment between sales, technical, and delivery teams.
* Ability to quickly learn, understand, and guide your team on emerging technologies and methodologies in the telecommunications and cloud space.
* Security, architecture, and industry certifications such as CCNP (Automation/Data Center/Wireless), ITIL Foundation, or equivalent.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.
  
  
Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Adoption Manager Content & Channel
description:
**Summary**
The Adoption Manager is responsible for driving hands-on adoption of Guided Buying across priority Layer-4 taxonomy sub-categories and rollout markets. The role converts category strategy into practical buying journeys, activates super-user networks, coordinates targeted enablement, and uses adoption data to improve user behavior and channel conversion. Success in this role means users are guided to the right buying channels because the experience is clear, relevant, and easier than off-channel alternatives.
  
 
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Adoption planning:**
  Develop sub-category adoption plans with category managers, defining the target buying channel, user groups, buying scenarios, adoption risks, and intervention plan for each wave.
* **Buying journey design:**
  Map how users buy today and define the future-state buying journey across catalogues, contract-linked purchase orders, preferred suppliers, tactical sourcing, or other approved routes.
* **Super-user activation:**
  Identify, engage, and manage super users by market, location, or user group; establish feedback loops and ensure user issues are captured, prioritised, and resolved.
* **Enablement and communications:**
  Partner with Change & Enablement and Experience teams to deliver targeted walkthroughs, Q&A, quick reference material, and nudges that address specific buying behaviours.
* **Data-led intervention:**
  Monitor adoption signals including Guided Buying usage, channel utilisation, free-text buying, off-channel activity, catalogue usage, contract operationalisation, and recurring user issues.
* **Issue resolution:**
  Work with C&C Operations, Local Procurement, category owners, supplier enablement, and BAU teams to resolve root causes such as content gaps, channel design issues, supplier readiness, data quality, or unclear ownership.
* **Governance and reporting:**
  Maintain the adoption tracker, manage actions and risks, provide progress updates to the Adoption Lead, and escalate decisions or blockers that put adoption targets at risk.

 
  
**Required Skills:**

* **P2P/S2P and procurement-channel adoption:**
  Approximately seven or more years in procurement or transformation, including direct work with guided buying, catalogues, contract-linked buying, or preferred-supplier routes to drive measurable change in adoption.
* **Hands-on adoption delivery:**
  Owned adoption plans, user segmentation, buying journeys, interventions, super-user networks, and issue resolution—not only communications or training.
* **Data-led problem solving:**
  Used channel-utilisation, free-text, off-channel, catalogue, contract, or user-issue data to diagnose causes and prioritise action to drive adoption metrics.
* **Influence across functions and markets:**
  Secured delivery from category, procurement operations, suppliers, technology, change, and local-market teams without direct authority.
* **Transformation delivery and ambiguity:**
  Delivered in a complex rollout, managed dependencies and risks, and converted unclear requirements into an actionable plan with governance.

 
  
**Preferred Skills:**

* **SAP Ariba ecosystem exposure:**
  Practical exposure to SAP Ariba Guided Buying, SLP, Supplier Business Network, or a comparable procurement platform.
* **BAU transition and repeatability:**
  Built a playbook, governance cadence, exit criteria, and named ownership to sustain adoption after rollout.

* Design engaging carousels, static posts, and Instagram Stories that encourage audiences to pause, read, share, and interact
* Use Adobe Premiere Pro and Canva to produce high-quality content consistent with brand guidelines
* Use faster editing tools when necessary to meet tight turnaround times without compromising quality
* Incorporate feedback and refine content to improve its effectiveness and overall presentation
* Content Quality and Delivery
* Ensure all content is accurate, visually appealing, engaging, and aligned with the brand's communication style
* Manage multiple content deliverables while maintaining consistency and meeting deadlines

* Understanding of video hooks, pacing, storytelling, sound selection, and audience retention
* Ability to create engaging Instagram Reels, carousels, static posts, and Stories
* Comfort with smartphone photography and videography, including framing and capturing usable footage

Good-to-Have Skills
  
  
  

* Experience creating content for Instagram and other social media platforms

* Experience in fitness, wellness, lifestyle, or health-related content creation

Success in this role means creating social media content that goes beyond simply filling a posting calendar. Your work should educate audiences, make them laugh, help them feel represented, and inspire them to make positive changes in their lives.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
**Experience**
: 5.00 + years
  
  
**Salary**
: INR 1500000.00 / year (based on experience)
  
  
**Expected Notice Period**
: 7 Days
  
  
**Shift**
: (GMT+05:30) Asia/Kolkata (IST)
  
  
**Opportunity Type**
: Office ()
  
  
**Placement Type**
: Full Time Permanent position(Payroll and Compliance to be managed by: Enterprise AI company building production-ready AI solutions)
  
  
**(\*Note: This is a requirement for one of Uplers' client - Enterprise AI company building production-ready AI solutions)
  
  
**What do you need for this opportunity?
  
  
**Must have skills required:**
Certifications in HubSpot, Google Ads or LinkedIn Marketing., Outstanding written and spoken Englis, Hands-on paid media ownership, marketing to US B2B
  
  
**Enterprise AI company building production-ready AI solutions is Looking for:******
**The opportunity**
We are hiring our first Marketing Lead. Most marketing roles hand you an inherited strategy and a brand settled years
  
  
before you arrived. This one gives you the pen. You get an opportunity to design and define the company''s marketing
  
  
strategy and execution.
  
  
Two things make this a good moment to take it on. Agentic AI is where enterprise software is moving right now, and
  
  
buyers in finance, operations and IT are actively looking for exactly what we build, so there is live demand to capture
  
  
rather than a category to invent. And you will be marketing AI products while using AI tools yourself every day, a
  
  
combination very few marketing roles offer and one that will compound your own value fast.
  
  
You will work directly with our US sales and business development leadership and our India leadership team, who
  
  
carry the customer conversation. You build and run everything that brings a buyer to that conversation.
  
  
**Brand and positioning**

* Positioning and messaging. Define what we stands for, who it is for and why a buyer should choose us.

Build the messaging architecture at company level and for each solution, since the buyer changes by function.
  
  

* Proof. Turn live customer work into evidence a US buyer finds credible: case studies, reference stories, outcome

narratives and use-case content.
  
  

* Website. Own the site as the main expression of the brand as well as a conversion surface. Structure, narrative,

solution pages and ongoing content, with in-house design and engineering support available to you.
  
  

* Company voice. Own LinkedIn and our public presence. Set the editorial voice and build leadership and

executive presence with content they will genuinely want to publish.
  
  

* Brand system. Create the guidelines, templates and asset library so that sales, pre-sales and delivery all present

one company.
  
  

* Discoverability. Own how buyers find us. Search, and equally the AI answer engines, since a growing share of our

market now researches through AI assistants before they ever open a search page.
  
  

* Credibility surfaces. Build our standing on the platforms where US software buyers check whether a vendor is

real, including G2, Capterra and Clutch.
  
  

* PR and analysts. Shape and coordinate external PR, media and analyst activity through agency partners.

**Demand generation**

* Own the plan. Build and run the US demand generation strategy, from ideal customer profile and personas

through to pipeline targets. Strategy, execution, tools, budget and results all sit with you.
  
  

* Paid campaigns. Plan, launch and optimize LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads and programmatic campaigns aimed at US

decision-makers, with real ownership of the budget and the performance.
  
  

* Account-based marketing. Run ABM against named target accounts alongside sales: account selection, intent

signals, personalized messaging and nurture, measured on account engagement and opportunities rather than
  
  
clicks.
  
  

* Content. Produce what a B2B buyer needs before they will take a call. Case studies, whitepapers, solution and

landing pages, webinars and sales collateral, hands-on, with AI tools and freelancers where they help.
  
  

* Lifecycle and automation. Own email, nurture and lifecycle automation in the CRM, including lead scoring and a

clean handover of qualified leads into sales.
  
  

* Search and conversion. Drive organic and paid search against US buyer intent, and own how well the site

converts.
  
  
**Partner and co-marketing**

* Build and run joint campaigns with distribution and channel partners, including co-branded content and shared

lead programs.
  
  

* Turn partner-supplied account lists into segmented, workable programs that produce conversations.
* Create partner-facing collateral that a partner''s own sellers will actually pick up and use: solution flyers, one-

pagers, battlecards and enablement material.
  
  

* Own our presence and listings across partner and cloud marketplaces.
* Run joint webinars, partner events and co-selling campaigns with partner marketing teams in the US.

**Measurement**

* Report the funnel weekly: spend, cost per lead, qualified leads, opportunities, pipeline, acquisition cost and

return, and move budget towards what is working.
  
  

* Build and own the marketing dashboard, and keep the CRM clean enough that marketing activity traces through

to pipeline.
  
  

* Track brand health alongside pipeline: branded search, direct traffic, share of voice, engagement and the quality

of inbound enquiries.
  
  

* Manage agencies, freelancers and tools within an agreed budget.

**What You Will Bring**

* Five to eight years in B2B marketing. We count years spent in marketing, so please state your total professional

experience and your total marketing experience separately.
  
  

* Experience marketing to US B2B (Mandatory), and an understanding of how a long, multi-stakeholder

enterprise sale really runs.
  
  

* A business-to-business background. Your buyer has been another company rather than a consumer.
* Technology, software or IT services. You have marketed a technology product or service and can hold a

conversation with a technical buyer.
  
  

* Hands-on paid media ownership. You have planned, run and optimized LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads with a

budget you controlled, and you can tell us what that budget was.
  
  

* Working depth in CRM and marketing automation. Day-to-day ownership of a platform such as HubSpot

(preferably), Zoho, Salesforce or Marketo, including nurture flows and lead scoring.
  
  

* Results you can show in real numbers. At least one outcome where you can give us the figure before, the figure

after and the period over which it moved.
  
  

* The appetite to run your own show. You set the plan, do the work and own the outcome. If you have been a

solo marketer or a first marketing hire before, that counts for a lot here.
  
  

* Outstanding written and spoken English that holds up with US enterprise buyers.
* Comfort working with regular overlap into US hours, including some early morning and evening calls.

**What Would Put You Ahead**
What would put you ahead
  
  

* Brand building at an early stage. You have taken a company or product from little recognition to real presence

and can tell us how you did it.
  
  

* Partner, channel or co-marketing experience, particularly with technology distributors, cloud providers or

marketplaces.
  
  

* Genuine working depth with AI tools. Not that you use ChatGPT, but that you have built workflows,

automations or campaigns around AI tools and can walk us through the process and the result.
  
  

* Intent and enrichment platforms such as ZoomInfo, Apollo, Clay, 6sense, Bombora or RollWorks.
* Answer-engine and AI search optimization.
* Experience marketing AI, cloud, finance automation or workforce software.
* Running webinars or events for overseas audiences.
* Working design or video capability with Canva, Figma or AI video tools, for fast creative turnaround.
* Certifications in HubSpot, Google Ads or LinkedIn Marketing.

**How We Hire**
Before we meet, we will send you a short written questionnaire. It asks for specifics: budgets you have run,
  
  
conversion rates you have achieved, campaigns and their results. We read it properly, and candidates who give us real
  
  
numbers consistently do better.
  
  
The conversations that follow are working ones. Expect to talk through how you would allocate a budget and what
  
  
you would expect it to produce. We would rather see how you think than hear a rehearsed answer.
  
  
If this sounds like the role you have been waiting to be handed, we would like to hear from you.
  
  
**How to apply for this opportunity?**

* Step 1: Click On Apply! And Register or Login on our portal.
* Step 2: Complete the Screening Form & Upload updated Resume
* Step 3: Increase your chances to get shortlisted & meet the client for the Interview!

**About Uplers:**
Our goal is to make hiring reliable, simple, and fast. Our role will be to help all our talents find and apply for relevant contractual onsite opportunities and progress in their career. We will support any grievances or challenges you may face during the engagement.
  
  
(Note: There are many more opportunities apart from this on the portal. Depending on the assessments you clear, you can apply for them as well).
  
  
So, if you are ready for a new challenge, a great work environment, and an opportunity to take your career to the next level, don't hesitate to apply today. We are waiting for you!

description:
**About Kinaxis**
Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
  
  
In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
  
  
Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
  
  
Location
  
  
India
  
  
**About The Role**
The
**Partner Success Manager**
is accountable for helping Kinaxis value added reseller (VAR) partners build productive, scalable, and predictable businesses around Kinaxis solutions. The role connects partner enablement, operating discipline, pipeline governance, and alliance management so that partners are equipped to create demand, progress opportunities, close business, and deliver a consistent customer experience.
  
  
This is a hands-on orchestration role. The Partner Success Manager works across VAR leadership, partner sellers and solution consultants, Kinaxis sales, pre-sales, marketing, services, customer success, operations, and legal teams. The successful candidate combines strong partner relationships with rigorous execution and uses data to identify risks, remove barriers, and improve partner performance.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Develop and manage role-based partner enablement, onboarding, certification, product training, and ongoing knowledge programs.
* Assess partner capabilities, identify readiness gaps, and drive remediation plans with clear milestones and ownership.
* Ensure partners can effectively position Kinaxis solutions, qualify opportunities, and leverage Kinaxis resources.
* Drive adoption of approved tools, processes, programs, and new product/solution launches.
* Establish and improve partner delivery readiness and standards to ensure consistent implementation quality and customer outcomes.
* Manage partner operations, governance, business reviews, pipeline cadence, scorecards, records, approvals, and action tracking.
* Partner with VAR sales leaders to build account plans, campaigns, qualified pipeline, and revenue opportunities.
* Lead pipeline reviews, monitor opportunity progression and CRM hygiene, and coordinate internal resources to advance priority deals.
* Analyze pipeline and sales performance metrics to identify risks and drive corrective actions.
* Build strong executive and functional relationships and develop joint business plans with partners.
* Align Kinaxis and partner stakeholders on priorities, responsibilities, investments, and execution.
* Identify opportunities to expand partner capabilities, market coverage, industry reach, and geographic presence.
* Represent partner needs internally while balancing customer outcomes and Kinaxis business priorities.

**Education Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

What we are looking for
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in partner management, channel sales or partner operations.
* Experience working with VARs, system integrators, software partners, or indirect go-to-market models.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software sales cycles, pipeline management, forecasting, account planning, and partner economics.
* Ability to translate strategy into actionable plans, measurable milestones, and effective execution across stakeholders.
* Strong relationship management, communication, presentation, facilitation, and executive engagement skills.
* Strong analytical capabilities with proficiency in CRM, reporting, collaboration, and productivity tools.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across regions and functions with sound judgment and attention to detail.
* Preferred: Experience in supply chain planning, SaaS, enterprise applications, or digital transformation.
* Preferred: Experience managing global/multi-regional partner portfolios, partner enablement, certifications, demand generation, channel programs, or complex co-sell models.

**#Intermediate, #Senior**
**Work With Impact:**
Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
  
  
**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:**
Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.
  
  
**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:**
Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
  
  
People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:
  
  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs, training, and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons

title: Product Management Senior Manager - VP
description:
The Product Management Senior Manager is a senior management level position responsible for managing a broad range of Product Management employees, setting strategy and providing direction, leadership and budgetary management, etc. Additionally, this role will be responsible for the development of product plans, strategies, and tactics while coordinating product lines through product life-cycles in coordination with the broader Product Management team. The overall objective of this role is to coordinate the promotion of products to develop new markets, increase share of market and obtain competitive position.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Manage a team of professional to accomplish established goals and conduct personnel duties for team (e.g. performance evaluations, hiring and disciplinary actions)
* Manage strategic program roadmap, program/product launch, and program marketing to gain maximum benefit from each product
* Monitor client and competitor market research to ensure successful execution of a marketing plan spanning product, brand, acquisition, customer and retention, and improving performance, brand preference, and client engagement
* Develop plans and execute functional strategies for a country, group of countries, region, or business requiring coordination and integration across units
* Manage day-to-day product marketing for core products such as product delivery, client experience, and client communication strategies as well as help the team prioritize, negotiate, and remove obstacles to achieve business results
* Participate in development of client valued propositions, positioning, segmentation, pricing, targeting, channel strategies, and competitive differentiation to achieve preferred status as a partner to Citi clients
* Oversee program life cycle including market demands, technology trends, and the competitive field as well as develop and communicate a business plan to approach the marketplace
* Define and launch new products, features, and capabilities including defining the product/feature and go-to-market strategy, and participate in technology development and market launch activities
* Engage with external partners and/or vendor relationships, engage in negotiations, manage ongoing relationships, and prepare agreements
* Deploy profitable marketing strategies, lead conceptualization and implementation of key growth initiatives, and maintain current market intelligence on the overall industry verticals and competitors
* Assist in building new relationships in supported verticals using available tools such as industry publications, direct mail, internet presence, trade shows, calls, and strategic alliances
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.

**Qualifications:**

* 10 plus years of relevant experience
* Previous supervisory experience across multi-function and/or global business
* Experience with banking and investment products
* Working knowledge of the different systems, theories, and practices relevant to a function as well as practical experience of multiple business cycles
* In-depth knowledge of industry and competitor products/services
* Working knowledge of industry practices and standards
* Working knowledge of strategic direction of the function within the business as well as a solid conceptual/practical grounding in function and/or area of expertise
* Ability to develop strategy, resources, and inspire a diverse set of individuals
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
* Demonstrated negotiation skills

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
* Master’s degree preferred

title: Senior Assistant Vice President
description:

About This Role EXL Health, a dedicated subdivision of EXL, is actively seeking a dynamic Product Manager to lead the development and management of innovative healthcare products focused on Fraud, Waste, and Abuse detection for US insurance Payment Integrity. This role is ideal for a creative problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, excels at documentation, and is adept at gathering detailed requirements. As a data-focused organization, we integrate advanced analytics and sophisticated data models into our platforms, enhancing the effectiveness and intelligence of our solutions. Responsibilities:
  
  

* Lead Product Vision and Strategy: Develop and communicate a clear vision for products that address complex challenges in healthcare, particularly in Fraud, Waste, and Abuse detection. Ensure products align with business goals and deliver substantial value.
* Manage Product Lifecycle: Oversee the entire product lifecycle, from ideation to launch and beyond. Use data-driven insights to inform product development and enhancements.

title: Sales Marketing Manager - B2B Exhibition
company: MIDAAS TOUCH EVENTS AND TRADE FAIRS LLP
description:
Sales & Marketing Manager – B2B Exhibitions

**Company:**
Midaas Touch Events & Trade Fairs LLP

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Job Type:**
Full-time | On-site

**Experience:**
1–5 Years

About Midaas Touch

MIDAAS TOUCH EVENTS AND TRADE FAIRS LLP is an emerging exhibition and trade fair organiser specialising in tailor-made B2B and B2C exhibitions across diverse industry sectors. We connect businesses, customers, and industry communities through impactful physical and virtual platforms.

Our services include exhibition and trade fair organisation, conferences, seminars, product launches, corporate events, and digital marketing solutions. We are committed to creating valuable business networking opportunities, strengthening industry connections, and delivering successful exhibition experiences for exhibitors and visitors.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive, target-driven
**Sales & Marketing Manager – B2B Exhibitions**
to drive exhibition space sales, acquire new exhibitors, develop corporate relationships, and achieve stall booking and revenue targets.

The ideal candidate should have strong sales, negotiation, client acquisition, and follow-up skills, with the ability to convert prospective clients into confirmed exhibitors. This role requires a hands-on professional who can manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and client meetings to stall booking, payment follow-ups, and post-sales coordination.

Key Responsibilities

* **Exhibition Space Sales:**
  Drive stall sales and exhibition space bookings for B2B trade fairs and industry exhibitions.
* **Lead Generation:**
  Identify and approach potential exhibitors, manufacturers, distributors, dealers, service providers, and corporate clients through calls, emails, networking, and field visits.
* **Client Acquisition:**
  Develop new business opportunities and convert qualified prospects into confirmed exhibitors.
* **Sales Meetings & Negotiations:**
  Conduct client meetings, present exhibition opportunities, explain participation benefits, negotiate commercial terms within approved limits, and close bookings.
* **Client Relationship Management:**
  Build and maintain long-term relationships with exhibitors, industry associations, business networks, and corporate partners.
* **End-to-End Sales Coordination:**
  Manage stall enquiries, quotations, booking confirmations, documentation, payment follow-ups, and after-sales support.
* **Sales Pipeline Management:**
  Maintain accurate lead databases, follow up consistently, update lead status, and track prospects, conversions, and pending payments using Excel or other CRM tools.
* **Target Achievement:**
  Work towards monthly, quarterly, and exhibition-wise sales targets, revenue goals, and stall occupancy commitments.
* **Market Research:**
  Identify potential exhibitor segments, industry trends, competitor exhibitions, and new business opportunities.
* **Marketing Coordination:**
  Support email campaigns, telemarketing, social media promotions, and other marketing activities to generate exhibitor enquiries and improve sales conversions.
* **Event Coordination:**
  Coordinate with internal teams and vendors to ensure smooth exhibitor onboarding and successful event execution.
* **On-site Representation:**
  Represent the company professionally at exhibitions, trade fairs, networking events, and client meetings.
* **Management Reporting:**
  Submit daily activity reports and weekly sales performance reports covering calls, meetings, leads generated, follow-ups, bookings, collections, and target progress.
* **Business Travel:**
  Travel within Chennai and to other Indian cities as required for client visits, business development, networking, and exhibitions.

What We’re Looking For

* A graduate in any discipline; an MBA in Marketing or Business Management is an added advantage.
* 1–5 years of experience in sales, business development, field marketing, exhibition sales, event sales, or space selling.
* Experience in exhibition stall sales, trade fair participation sales, or B2B client acquisition will be preferred.
* Excellent communication, presentation, persuasion, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Strong follow-up discipline and the ability to convert leads into confirmed business.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to maintain accurate sales records, prepare reports, and manage multiple prospects simultaneously.
* A proactive, target-oriented, and accountable approach to work.
* Willingness to meet clients face-to-face and travel for business requirements.
* Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with the management and internal teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Client calls, meetings, and visits completed.
* Exhibition space enquiries converted into confirmed stall bookings.
* Sales revenue generated and targets achieved.
* Follow-up effectiveness and payment collection progress.
* Accuracy of sales pipeline records and timely reporting.
* Client satisfaction and relationship development.

Why Join Midaas Touch?

* Opportunity to work with a growing exhibition and trade fair organiser.
* Exposure to multiple industrial sectors and B2B business networks.
* Opportunities to develop sales, negotiation, networking, and business development expertise.
* A performance-driven role with direct involvement in exhibition revenue generation and business growth.

**If you are passionate about sales, enjoy meeting clients, and have the confidence to turn business opportunities into successful deals, we would like to hear from you.**

* **Apply now to join Midaas Touch Events & Trade Fairs LLP and grow with us in the exhibition industry.**
