title: Associate Director, Projects Pursuits
description:
**Job Description**
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Build and expand Emerson’s preferred or exclusive specification status across assigned GECs and product lines.
* Lead early engagement with engineering teams and stakeholders to influence specifications and project outcomes.
* Develop and execute structured account strategies, including playbooks, pipeline visibility, and opportunity mapping.
* Collaborate with global and regional teams to align pursuit strategies, share insights, and ensure consistent customer engagement.
* Guide commercial awareness by supporting frame agreements and tracking specification-to-order conversion performance.
* Design and deliver technical training programs to enhance customer engagement and support specification adoption.
* Lead, coach, and develop a geographically distributed team, fostering collaboration and accountability.
* Maintain accurate CRM data, provide regular reporting, and use insights to drive decision-making and continuous improvement.
* Build strong, trusted relationships with stakeholders across multiple engineering and project functions.
* Develop and maintain a multi-level training plan per assigned Global Engineering Center, including awareness sessions, product application training, and advanced technical workshops; position training as a strategic specification and preference tool. Review equivalent plans developed and maintained by the Project Pursuit Senior Managers.
* Partner with Global Strategic Account Managers and Global Strategic Accounts & Specification Managers to align pursuit strategies and deliver consistent stakeholder messaging for Global Engineering Centers.
* Share account intelligence, specification activity, and project pipeline updates with Global Strategic Account counterparts; support and oversee approved vendor list qualification, Global Frame Agreement utilization, and licensor engagement activities at the Global Engineering Center level, serving as the in-country leadership interface between global programs and the national field team.

**Who You Are:**
You build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives, while balancing multiple priorities to achieve results aligned with organizational goals. You proactively identify opportunities and take action to address challenges, using data and insights to guide decisions and continuously improve outcomes. You communicate effectively across diverse audiences, adapting your approach to influence and build trust, and you develop people through coaching, feedback, and creating opportunities that enable growth and performance.
  
  
**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* A bachelor’s degree in engineering or a relevant technical field (such as instrumentation, electrical, mechanical, or chemical engineering).
* A minimum of 10 years of related experience required; 12+ years preferred.
* Experience engaging with engineering teams, EPC contractors, or owner-operators in industrial automation, instrumentation, or related fields.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical specifications, vendor qualification processes, or project outcomes.
* Experience leading or mentoring individuals or teams, with a focus on collaboration and development.
* Understanding of the project lifecycle from early design through procurement and execution.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, priorities, and projects in a dynamic environment.
* Familiarity with customer relationship management (CRM) systems and data-driven decision-making.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver technical training or product capability sessions to engineering audiences, including drafting structured, multi-level training plans.
* Experience engaging or coordinating with global or strategic account management teams on shared accounts including aligning pursuit strategies and sharing structured account intelligence.
* Willingness and ability to travel as needed to support customers and team collaboration (approximately 25–30%).

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**

* Experience working with global or strategic accounts and collaborating across regions or functions.
* Background in managing distributed or cross-functional teams.
* Exposure to industries such as energy, oil and gas, chemicals, power, data centers, or similar sectors.
* Familiarity with engineering design or specification tools and platforms.
* Advanced education or professional development in business, engineering, or leadership (or equivalent practical experience).
* Experience supervising team members located in diverse locations.
* Experience supporting or executing global Approved Vendor List qualification efforts, Global Frame Agreement utilization, and licensor engagement programs at a local or regional level.

**Our Culture & Commitment to You:**
At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

title: Senior PMM (IC3)
description:
**About Everstage Inc.**
Everstage is the leading sales compensation and SPM platform. We automate commissions, quota and capacity planning, territory design, and real-time payout visibility for sales teams globally.
  
  
We're heading into the most exciting chapter of our story so far, a global brand refresh is about to go live, the leadership team is showing up more publicly and gaining followers and we want our social channels to feel less like a corporate handle and more like a creator brand.
  
  
That's where you come in.
  
  
**About The Role**
Everstage is hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to lead go-to-market for major launches across our revenue platform: Everstage Incentives, Everstage Planning, and Everstage CPQ. You will own product storytelling and differentiation for your product areas, run projects end to end, and be accountable for launch impact. You will work directly with senior leaders in Product, Sales, and Customer Success, and help shape how customers experience and advocate for Everstage.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own GTM strategy for major product launches, from positioning and messaging through sales enablement, launch campaigns, and post-launch measurement.
* Lead product storytelling and differentiation, including how we position our AI capabilities against how buyers run incentives, quoting, and planning today.
* Develop market segmentation and narrative for key buyer personas: RevOps leaders, Sales Ops, Finance, and sales reps.
* Synthesize customer insights, competitive analysis, and market trends into sharper positioning, and bring those insights into roadmap conversations with Product leadership.
* Lead multi-format content campaigns across web, email, social, events, and sales enablement.
* Build sales tools that win deals: pitch decks, demo narratives, battle cards, and objection handling for competitive situations.
* Build and grow Everstage's customer marketing program: launch and manage a customer reference program, turn customer wins into case studies and video testimonials with measurable outcomes, grow our presence on peer review sites, recruit customers to speak at webinars and events, and set up structured feedback channels, such as customer interviews and advisory board sessions, that feed messaging and roadmap decisions.
* Influence cross-functional peers and leadership on launch priorities, timing, and success metrics.

**What You'll Bring**

* 3 to 5 years of product marketing experience in enterprise or technical B2B SaaS.
* Experience in Sales Performance Management (SPM), Incentive Compensation Management (ICM), or Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ). You know how RevOps, Sales Ops, and Finance teams buy and use these tools.
* Exceptional writing skills. You can take a complex concept and turn it into a clear, simple copy a busy RevOps leader understands in one read.
* Experience marketing AI products or AI-powered features, and a working knowledge of how buyers evaluate AI in enterprise software.
* A track record of owning major launches end to end, with results you can point to. You know how to bring Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing together around one plan and keep them aligned through launch day and beyond.
* Deep technical acumen. You can learn a complex product quickly and explain it in plain language tied to a business outcome.
* Comfort working with senior stakeholders and managing projects autonomously.
* Experience building and growing a customer marketing program is preferred. Ideally you have launched a reference program, shipped case studies and video testimonials, or run a customer advisory board, and you can show how that work helped Sales win deals.

title: Frontier Foundation Lead
description:
**Leading at Cognizant**
This is a Leadership role at Cognizant. We believe how you lead is as important as what you deliver. Cognizant leaders at every level:
**Drive our business strategy**
and inspire teams around our future.
**Live the leadership behaviors**
, leading themselves, others and the business.
**Uphold our Values**
, role modeling them in every action and decision.
**Nurture our people and culture**
, creating a workplace where all can thrive.
  
  
At Cognizant, leadership transcends titles and is embodied in actions and behaviors. We empower our leaders at every level to drive business strategy, inspire teams, uphold our values, and foster an inclusive culture.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Frontier Foundation Lead, you will make an impact by building the reusable intellectual capital of the Frontier Capability Unit (FCU) - the offerings, methodologies, accelerators, tools and assets that give SEG's AI-native engagement model its edge - and taking that capital to market and into client delivery. You will be a valued member of the Frontier Capability Unit team and work collaboratively with SEG Solutioning, GSA, the IDU and Frontier Talent community, hyperscaler and model partners, industry analysts, and clients.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own the offering and accelerator roadmap across Agentic Coding & ADLC, Autonomous Agents & Runtime and Vertical Solutions, including domain and hyperscaler-specific offerings, and sponsor the Garage / R&D build of new assets and proof points ahead of client demand.
* Build and maintain delivery kits, composable tooling (MCP & Skills), delivery methodology and pod-design patterns consumed by the IDU and the Frontier Talent community, owning their availability and quality.
* Own the asset / IP register for the unit and the Enterprise Runtime & Governance standard that assets must meet before they are published for re-use.
* Supply estimation models, productivity guidance and Assurance & Evaluation proof points into new and vendor-consolidation deals, and co-create bid support with SEG Solutioning / GSA.
* Own hyperscaler, model-partner (Anthropic, Google / Gemini, OpenAI) and Agentic Trust & Security ecosystem relationships and represent the FCU's capability to industry analysts.
* Consistently demonstrate the Cognizant Way to Lead, which means operating with Personal Leadership (building trust, collaboration, and inclusion), Organizational Leadership (driving vision and purpose, demonstrating a strategic and enterprise mindset, and creating and communicating a bold direction that inspires purpose), and Business Leadership (exemplifying client focus, managing ambiguity with accountability and results, and operating with financial acumen)

**What You Need To Have To Be Considered**

* 20+ years in IT services, with 10+ years in AI-native / GenAI engineering, solutioning or offering & IP leadership.
* Strong technical / solutioning grounding in AI-native and GenAI engineering, credible enough to set an offering roadmap and engage architects and partners.
* A proven track record of taking IP to market through pre-sales support, accelerator build, and analyst / partner engagement.
* Experience building estimation and proof-point models for bids.
* A builder-evangelist profile with market-facing scope, able to lead a direct and indirect span of 20-30 across pillar-aligned focus areas.
* Embodiment of the Cognizant Way to Lead: Leading Self, Leading Others, & Leading the Business
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The right Thing, & Own It

**These will help you succeed**

* Working knowledge of major model and cloud ecosystems — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google / Gemini, Azure, AWS and GCP.
* Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and determine enterprise readiness.
* Experience designing reference architectures, engineering standards and delivery patterns.
* Strong market-sensing skills that convert frontier technology trends into a forward offering roadmap.
* Experience industrialising reusable offerings, accelerators and methodologies that differentiate at scale.

**Work model**
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role's business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Head - Admissions and Marketing - GO/JC/4830/2026
description:
**Job Details**
**Job Title:**
Head – Admissions & Marketing
  
  
**Job Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu
  
  
**Work Model:**
Work from Office
  
  
**Job Level:**
Head / Senior Leadership
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Candidate Expectations**
**Total Experience:**
15+ years preferred.
  
  
**Relevant Experience:**
Significant experience in admissions management, student recruitment,
  
  
education marketing, institutional branding, and enrolment strategy.
  
  
**Candidate Location:**
Chennai preferred; candidates willing to relocate may be considered.
  
  
**Mandatory Skills**
Admissions strategy and enrolment management.
  
  
Marketing strategy, institutional branding, and student outreach.
  
  
Lead generation, applicant conversion, and enrolment growth.
  
  
Experience across Medical, Hospital/Healthcare, and Engineering education.
  
  
Digital marketing, campaign management, and performance analytics.
  
  
Team leadership, stakeholder management, and budget oversight.
  
  
Admissions governance and applicable regulatory compliance.
  
  
**Preferred Industry:**
Universities, higher education institutions, medical colleges, healthcare education institutions, and engineering institutions.
  
  
**Leadership Expectations:**
Ability to lead integrated admissions and marketing functions, drive student enrolment, strengthen institutional positioning, and deliver measurable growth.
  
  
**Education & Certification**
**Mandatory:**
Postgraduate qualification in Management, Marketing, Education Administration, or a relevant discipline.
  
  
**Preferred:**
MBA / PGDM in Marketing or a related specialisation.
  
  
**Good to Have:**
Certifications in digital marketing, brand management, education management, or strategic leadership.
  
  
**Additional Preference:**
Experience in multidisciplinary universities or institutions offering medical, healthcare-related, and engineering programmes.
  
  
**Detailed Job Description**
**Role Overview**
The Head of Admissions & Marketing will lead the institution’s integrated admissions, marketing, student recruitment, and branding functions across Medical, Hospital/Healthcare, and Engineering education. The role will be responsible for developing strategies to strengthen institutional visibility, generate prospective student enquiries, improve application-to-enrolment conversion, and achieve programme-wise admission targets.
  
  
The position requires a strategic leader who can align marketing initiatives with admissions objectives, build effective recruitment channels, enhance the student acquisition journey, and ensure efficient and compliant admissions operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Admissions Strategy & Enrolment Management**
Develop and execute institution-wide admissions strategies aligned with annual enrolment targets, programme capacity, and institutional growth objectives.
  
  
Establish programme-wise admission plans, recruitment calendars, conversion targets, and performance metrics.
  
  
Oversee the complete admissions funnel, from enquiry generation and application processing to counselling, selection, and final enrolment.
  
  
Monitor admission performance and implement initiatives to improve application volumes, conversion rates, and seat utilisation.
  
  
**Marketing Strategy & Institutional Branding**
Develop and implement integrated marketing strategies to strengthen institutional positioning and attract prospective students across Medical, Healthcare, and Engineering programmes.
  
  
Lead brand positioning, promotional campaigns, communication strategies, and outreach initiatives.
  
  
Drive digital and offline marketing activities, including website campaigns, social media, search marketing, education fairs, events, and targeted promotional programmes.
  
  
Ensure consistency in institutional messaging, programme communication, and marketing collateral.
  
  
Identify emerging student preferences, market trends, competitor positioning, and opportunities to improve institutional visibility.
  
  
**Student Recruitment & Lead Generation**
Build and execute strategies to generate qualified student enquiries through digital channels, school and college outreach, counselling networks, education fairs, and other relevant platforms.
  
  
Develop relationships with schools, colleges, education counsellors, and other recruitment partners.
  
  
Establish lead management and follow-up processes to improve enquiry-to-application and application-to-enrolment conversion.
  
  
Collaborate with admissions counsellors to improve prospective student engagement and the overall admission experience.
  
  
Track the effectiveness of recruitment channels and optimise campaigns based on conversion performance.
  
  
**Medical & Healthcare Admissions**
Oversee admissions for medical and healthcare-related programmes in accordance with applicable eligibility criteria, regulatory requirements, and prescribed counselling procedures.
  
  
Coordinate with academic departments and relevant authorities to ensure transparent and timely admissions.
  
  
Align marketing and outreach activities with programme-specific admission requirements and approved communication guidelines.
  
  
**Engineering Admissions**
Lead admissions planning and student recruitment for engineering and technology programmes.
  
  
Drive programme-specific outreach, applicant engagement, counselling, and conversion initiatives.
  
  
Work with academic departments to align recruitment campaigns with programme capacity, student demand, and enrolment objectives.
  
  
**Digital Marketing & Performance Analytics**
Oversee digital marketing campaigns, lead generation platforms, CRM systems, and admissions-related technology.
  
  
Establish dashboards to monitor marketing expenditure, lead volumes, cost per lead, application conversion, enrolment rates, and campaign effectiveness.
  
  
Use data-driven insights to improve campaign performance, recruitment efficiency, and return on marketing investment.
  
  
Strengthen digital engagement through targeted communication, applicant nurturing, and streamlined admissions journeys.
  
  
**Team Leadership & Budget Management**
Lead admissions, marketing, branding, outreach, and student recruitment teams.
  
  
Define team structures, responsibilities, performance objectives, and accountability mechanisms.
  
  
Develop and manage marketing and admissions budgets, ensuring optimal resource utilisation.
  
  
Build a collaborative operating model between marketing, admissions, academic departments, and institutional leadership.
  
  
Review team performance and drive continuous improvement in service delivery and business outcomes.
  
  
**Governance & Stakeholder Management**
Ensure admissions processes comply with applicable statutory requirements, regulatory guidelines, and institutional policies.
  
  
Establish standard operating procedures for admissions, marketing approvals, campaign execution, and reporting.
  
  
Collaborate with senior management and academic leaders on enrolment planning, programme launches, institutional positioning, and growth initiatives.
  
  
Present periodic reviews covering admission performance, marketing effectiveness, budget utilisation, and strategic recommendations.
  
  
**Key Skills**
**Mandatory Skills**
Admissions strategy and enrolment management.
  
  
Education marketing and institutional branding.
  
  
Student recruitment, lead generation, and conversion.
  
  
Digital marketing and campaign management.
  
  
Marketing analytics, MIS, and budget management.
  
  
Medical/Healthcare and Engineering education exposure.
  
  
Team leadership and cross-functional stakeholder management.
  
  
Admissions process governance and regulatory compliance.
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
Experience managing integrated admissions and marketing functions at a university or large educational institution.
  
  
Exposure to multiple academic disciplines and programme portfolios.
  
  
Knowledge of CRM, marketing automation, student information systems, and digital recruitment platforms.
  
  
Experience in institutional repositioning, brand-building, and market expansion.
  
  
Demonstrated success in improving enrolment, conversion rates, and marketing ROI.
  
  
Experience managing external agencies, education partners, and recruitment networks.
  
  
**Other Specific Remarks**
Candidates should have leadership experience spanning both admissions and marketing, rather than exposure limited to admissions counselling or marketing execution.
  
  
Preference for candidates with multidisciplinary higher education experience across Medical/Healthcare and Engineering programmes.
  
  
Strong ownership of enrolment targets, student acquisition, institutional branding, and marketing budgets is expected.
  
  
Candidates should demonstrate the ability to integrate marketing-generated leads with admissions conversion and final enrolment outcomes.
  
  
Experience in university-level administration and collaboration with senior academic leadership will be an advantage.
  
  
The role requires a strategic, data-driven leader capable of managing large teams and delivering measurable institutional growth.

title: Senior Product Marketing Specialist
description:
Zafin is an AI platform company helping regulated institutions modernize how critical work is designed, governed, and delivered. Our technology enables organizations to move faster while maintaining the governance, accountability, and control required in highly regulated environments.
  
  
Our portfolio includes
**Zafin AIOS**
, an agent orchestration platform for governed AI work; the
**Zafin Banking Platform**
, which helps banks modernize product, pricing, offers, billing, loyalty, and relationship management; and
**Zafin IO**
, an integration platform that connects data, systems, and workflows across complex enterprise environments.
  
  
Headquartered in Toronto, Canada, Zafin partners with leading financial institutions across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific. As AI transforms the future of financial services, we're building the platforms that help regulated organizations adopt AI responsibly and at scale.
  
  
**Senior Product Marketing Specialist**
**Location:**
Chennai, India (Hybrid)
  
  
**Function:**
Marketing
  
  
**Reports to:**
Director, Product Marketing
  
  
**About Zafin**
Zafin is an AI platform company for regulated institutions. We help organizations modernize complex operations, introduce new capabilities and execute with greater intelligence, control and accountability.
  
  
Our portfolio includes Zafin AIOS for governed agentic AI, the Zafin Banking Platform for product, pricing, offers, billing, loyalty and relationship management, and Zafin IO for enterprise integration.
  
  
As we continue to expand our platforms and market presence, Product Marketing plays a critical role in connecting what we build with the problems our customers need to solve.
  
  
What is the opportunity?
  
  
We are looking for an experienced B2B SaaS product marketer who can turn market and customer insights into clear positioning, compelling messaging and focused go-to-market programs.
  
  
As a Senior Product Marketing Specialist, you will take ownership of Product Marketing workstreams for assigned platforms, solutions and strategic initiatives. Working with the Director of Product Marketing, you will translate product and market priorities into differentiated messaging, go-to-market plans, customer-facing narratives and measurable market activity.
  
  
This is a hands-on, highly cross-functional role. You will work closely with Product, Sales, Pre-Sales, Industry Advisory, Market Intelligence and teams across Marketing to bring our platforms to market and communicate their value to customers.
  
  
We are also looking for someone who is fluent in using AI for Product Marketing. You should be comfortable creating repeatable workflows and AI-enabled processes that improve the quality, speed and scale of the team's work.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
**Market and customer insights**

* Partner with Market Intelligence and draw on customer, prospect, Sales and Product insights to understand buyer needs, market dynamics and competitive alternatives.
* Translate research and market signals into actionable Product Marketing recommendations.
* Build a strong understanding of buyer personas, customer challenges, purchasing considerations and competitive differentiation.
* Stay close to customer and prospect conversations to understand how our positioning and messaging resonate in the market.

**Product positioning and messaging**

* Develop clear product positioning, value propositions and messaging for buyers, champions and users.
* Translate complex technical capabilities into compelling narratives that connect product functionality with customer needs and business outcomes.
* Maintain and refine messaging based on customer feedback, competitive developments, product evolution and market priorities.
* Work closely with Product and technical teams to develop a strong understanding of our platforms, capabilities and use cases.

**Go-to-market strategy and execution**

* Develop and execute go-to-market plans for assigned products, solutions and initiatives, aligned with Zafin's broader Product Marketing priorities.
* Translate agreed target segments and commercial priorities into focused launch objectives, activities and measures of success.
* Drive assigned product launches and go-to-market initiatives from planning through execution, working with Product, Sales, Pre-Sales, Industry Advisory and teams across Marketing.
* Coordinate cross-functional activities to ensure launches are well planned, aligned and delivered effectively.
* Evaluate launch performance and recommend improvements to future go-to-market initiatives.

**Product narratives, content and commercial support**

* Develop product narratives, messaging briefs and priority Product Marketing materials, including solution briefs, product presentations, competitive positioning and launch content.
* Partner with Brand, Integrated Marketing and other teams to translate Product Marketing priorities into campaigns, case studies, thought leadership, videos, webinars and other market-facing content.
* Work with Sales, Pre-Sales and Industry Advisory to understand customer conversations, common objections and competitive challenges.
* Develop messaging, competitive insights and customer-facing materials that help commercial teams communicate Zafin's value clearly and consistently.
* Support campaigns, PR activities and market activation around product launches and announcements.

**Performance and continuous improvement**

* Work with Integrated Marketing to evaluate launch and campaign performance against agreed objectives.
* Gather feedback from customer-facing teams, customers and market activity to understand what is working and where improvements are needed.
* Use performance data, customer insights and competitive intelligence to continuously improve messaging, positioning and go-to-market execution.
* Contribute to market awareness, customer engagement and new-logo and expansion opportunities through effective Product Marketing initiatives.

**AI-enabled Product Marketing**

* Use AI thoughtfully across research, synthesis, competitive analysis, messaging development and execution.
* Develop repeatable AI-enabled workflows, templates and processes that improve the team's productivity, consistency and quality of work.
* Experiment with new approaches and tools while maintaining strong judgment, accuracy and accountability for outputs.
* Share practical AI-enabled methods and learnings that help improve how the broader Product Marketing team operates.

What you bring
  
  

* 4–6+ years of experience in B2B SaaS Product Marketing or enterprise software marketing, with demonstrable experience in core Product Marketing responsibilities.
* Experience taking ownership of Product Marketing initiatives, including positioning, messaging, product launches or go-to-market programs.
* Strong understanding of Product Marketing principles, frameworks and methodologies, and the ability to apply them pragmatically.
* Excellent writing, communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to make complex technical concepts clear and relevant to different audiences.
* Strong analytical thinking, commercial judgment and the ability to distinguish between product features and what actually matters to customers.
* Experience using market research, customer insights and performance data to inform decisions.
* The ability to collaborate effectively across Product, Sales, Marketing and technical teams.
* Curiosity about technology and the willingness to get into the details of a product, understand how it works and ask thoughtful questions of technical and commercial stakeholders.
* The ability to independently manage priorities, move work forward and deliver high-quality output in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment.
* A proactive approach to problem-solving, with the confidence to challenge assumptions, recommend improvements and take ownership of outcomes.
* A growth mindset and a habit of bringing new ideas, frameworks and practices into your work.
* A bachelor's degree in marketing, Business or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Working with AI
  
  
AI should be part of how you work, not simply a tool you use occasionally.
  
  
At Zafin, we expect our teams to use AI to improve how they think, create and execute. You should be comfortable using Microsoft Copilot and other approved enterprise AI tools to accelerate research, synthesis, content development and Product Marketing execution.
  
  
More importantly, you should be able to demonstrate how you have applied AI in your work, including creating repeatable workflows, templates or processes that improve speed, consistency and quality.
  
  
We value people who know when to use AI, how to validate its outputs and where human judgment makes the difference.
  
  
Bonus points
  
  

* Experience in financial services, banking or fintech.
* Experience marketing enterprise software to banks or financial institutions.
* Familiarity with banking technology, compliance or regulated markets.
* Experience with account-based marketing and enterprise sales motions.
* Experience supporting long sales cycles and tailoring marketing to strategic accounts.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
We are looking for a dynamic, strategic, and execution-oriented 
**Brand Marketing, PR & Influencer Relations Manager**

The ideal candidate will be responsible for building brand awareness, developing strategic partnerships, managing public relations, driving influencer collaborations, and planning and executing high-impact brand launches and events.

This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, strong industry connections, creative campaign development, and hands-on execution. The candidate will work closely with the founders and take ownership of key brand-building initiatives from concept to execution.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Brand Marketing & Strategy**

* Develop and execute comprehensive brand marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.

* Conceptualise innovative marketing campaigns, brand activations, and promotional initiatives.
* Identify strategic partnerships and collaboration opportunities to accelerate brand growth.
* Track campaign performance, marketing expenditure, and return on investment.

**2. Public Relations & Media Management**

* Develop and maintain relationships with media houses, journalists, publications, PR agencies, and relevant industry stakeholders.
* Drive press coverage, media features, brand announcements, and publicity initiatives.
* Develop PR strategies to generate brand awareness and establish a strong market presence.
* Coordinate press releases, media interactions, interviews, and brand communications.

**3. Influencer Marketing & Celebrity Collaborations**

* Develop and execute influencer marketing strategies across relevant social media platforms.
* Identify, negotiate, onboard, and manage influencers, content creators, and celebrity collaborations.
* Build and maintain a strong network of influencers and talent agencies.
* Coordinate campaign briefs, content deliverables, timelines, and performance tracking.
* Negotiate collaboration fees and maximise campaign reach within approved budgets.

**4. Brand Launches & Event Management**

* Plan and execute end-to-end brand launch events, influencer previews, media events, and promotional activations.
* Manage event conceptualisation, budgeting, venue coordination, vendors, production, and execution.
* Coordinate influencer attendance, celebrity appearances, media participation, and event coverage.
* Develop launch campaigns designed to generate pre-launch anticipation, launch-day visibility, and sustained post-launch engagement.
* Ensure all events and activations are delivered within approved budgets and timelines.

**5. Campaign Execution & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate with internal teams, creative agencies, designers, production teams, and external vendors.
* Manage campaign calendars, marketing deliverables, budgets, and execution timelines.
* Oversee the development of marketing collaterals, promotional content, and campaign assets.
* Monitor campaign outcomes and recommend improvements based on performance and market feedback.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* 3–6 years of relevant experience in brand marketing, public relations, influencer marketing, or event management.
* Demonstrated experience in executing brand launches, influencer campaigns, and PR initiatives.
* Strong professional network across influencers, media, celebrities, and event partners.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
* Strong project management, budgeting, and execution capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency in social media platforms, influencer campaign management, and marketing analytics.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in F&B, QSR, hospitality, lifestyle, fashion, or consumer-facing brands.
* Prior experience launching a new brand or scaling an emerging brand.
* Experience working with PR agencies, influencer management agencies, or event production companies.
* A demonstrable portfolio of successful campaigns, brand launches, and influencer collaborations.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Brand awareness and reach generated through marketing initiatives.
* Number and quality of influencer and strategic brand collaborations.
* Media coverage and PR visibility secured.
* Successful execution of launch events and marketing activations.
* Marketing budget utilisation and campaign return on investment.
* Timely execution of campaigns and achievement of agreed marketing objectives.

Reporting Structure

The candidate will report directly to the founders and collaborate closely with internal teams and external marketing partners.

**Work Requirement:**
 This is a full-time, work-from-office position based in Chennai, with flexibility to work during events, launches, and other brand activities outside standard office hours when required.

* **Ideal Candidate:**
   A proactive marketing professional who combines strategic thinking, strong industry relationships, creative problem-solving, and the ability to independently execute brand-building initiatives from the ground up.

**About The Role**
Cognizant’s Industry Solutions Group (ISG) is seeking a senior TPM & RGM Practice SME for the Consumer Goods practice. This individual will serve as Cognizant’s primary domain authority for Trade Promotion Management and Revenue Growth Management — driving pre-sales solutioning, building platform alliances, representing Cognizant at industry forums, and providing functional advisory support on client engagements.
  
  
Primary platform focus: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud TPM (first preference) and XTEL TPM/RGM (second preference).
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Domain & Solutioning Leadership
  
  

* Serve as the TPM/RGM domain authority across Cognizant’s Consumer Goods practice — designing end-to-end solution architectures covering trade planning, fund management, promotion execution, deduction management, and RGM analytics.
* Lead client solution design workshops and discovery sessions, driving alignment between business objectives (volume, margin, trade ROI) and platform capabilities.

Pre-Sales & Bid Support
  
  

* Lead RFP/RFI responses as the primary TPM/RGM domain voice — authoring solution narratives, effort models, and PoC demonstrations for Salesforce CG Cloud and XTEL engagements.
* Collaborate with Sales and Delivery teams on pursuit strategy and competitive positioning; build and maintain reusable solution accelerators, proposal templates, and reference architectures.

Thought Leadership & Practice Development
  
  

* Publish whitepapers, point-of-view papers, and industry blogs on TPM/RGM trends, platform innovations, and CPG commercial technology; represent Cognizant at conferences and speaking engagements.
* Build and contribute to Cognizant’s TPM/RGM CoE — defining best practices, developing delivery playbooks and reusable assets, and mentoring junior consultants within the Consumer Goods practice.

Alliance & Partnership Management
  
  

* Serve as Cognizant’s primary relationship manager with key TPM/RGM platform partners — Salesforce CG Cloud, XTEL, and relevant ISVs — nurturing joint GTM engagement, co-sell pipeline, and aligned solution roadmaps.
* Track partner roadmaps and identify partnership opportunities with CPG ecosystem players (o9, Anaplan, BluePlanner) to extend Cognizant’s TPM/RGM service portfolio; develop joint collateral and partner sales plays.

Industry Forum Participation & External Engagement
  
  

* Represent Cognizant at CPG technology conferences and industry forums (Salesforce Consumer Goods Summit, CGT events, XTEL user groups); deliver presentations and panel discussions on trade transformation and AI-driven RGM.
* Engage analyst communities (Gartner, Forrester, IDC) to position Cognizant’s capabilities; build an external professional network across CPG trade marketing and technology communities to generate leads and surface new service opportunities.

Techno-Functional Lead — Customer Project Support
  
  

* Serve as senior functional advisor on select engagements — providing domain expertise during blueprint, fit-gap, and go-live phases without owning day-to-day workstream delivery.
* Act as the functional escalation point for delivery teams — resolving complex design decisions and conducting periodic quality reviews of solution documents and test plans.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**
Domain & Technical Skills
  
  

* Deep functional expertise in TPM (trade planning, fund management, promotion execution, settlement, deduction management, post-event analytics) and RGM (pricing strategy, pack-price architecture, mix management, net revenue optimization).
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud TPM (primary) — account planning, fund configuration, promotion lifecycle, deduction management, and MuleSoft integration patterns.
* Hands-on experience with XTEL TPM/RGM (second preference) — trade fund setup, promotion planning, claims processing, and SAP/Oracle ERP integration architecture.
* Experience on at least 2 full-cycle TPM/RGM implementations; proficiency in delivery artifacts (BRDs, fit-gap documents, configuration workbooks, UAT scripts) and platform partner/alliance engagement.

Pre-Sales & Consulting Skills
  
  

* Excellent executive communication and presentation skills — able to influence VP/Director-level stakeholders; proven track record contributing to and winning CPG/Consumer Goods RFPs.
* Strong analytical and problem-structuring skills; ability to translate business challenges into platform solutions and produce high-quality proposals, PoVs, and solution collateral.

**A. About Mercados Energy Markets India Pvt. Ltd**

Mercados Energy Markets India Pvt. Ltd. (Mercados) is a specialist consultancy firm, exclusively focused on business solutions in the energy and environment domain. Having begun our operations in India in 2008 supporting clients across the energy sector, we strive to promote efficient and sustainable energy markets; design effective regulations and assist energy businesses to succeed. Our approach integrates innovative, state-of-the-art techniques with practical, tailor-made solutions to solve current energy sector challenges. We have permanent offices in New Delhi (head office), Gurgaon, Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Pune and Lucknow. Mercados has presence across the Energy Value Chain and serves Clients both in the public and private domain. Mercados operates under two broad verticals, namely ‘Management Consulting’ and ‘Enterprise SaaS’. The Director / Associate Director – Management Consulting will be responsible for driving business growth and leading consulting engagements across Power Markets, Regulatory & Policy, Distribution Operations, and commercial matters related to Generation, Distribution, Transmission & Renewables Space. The role involves Business Development, selling Mercados' existing portfolio of solutions to new and existing clients, client leadership, team management, and quality assurance across projects, including bid process management for power procurement, evaluation of new initiatives, internal feasibility assessments, and preparation of concept notes and thought leadership papers. The AD/D is also expected to lead the development of high-quality presentations for senior client leadership, conferences, webinars, and seminars.

**C. Detailed expectations from the role:**

* The Director / Associate Director will report to senior leadership and will have end-to-end ownership of business growth, client relationships, and project delivery, with a key focus on managing and expanding Mercados' presence in the Southern region market. Key expectations include:
* Drive business development in the Southern region, identifying new opportunities and building a strong pipeline of consulting mandates.
* Lead efforts to sell Mercados' existing portfolio of solutions and services to new and existing clients across the region.
* Lead and manage multiple ongoing and future consulting assignments in the power and renewable energy sector, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality outputs.
* Provide strategic advisory on energy policies, regulations, incentives, and reforms related to power generation, power procurement, and renewable energy.
* Oversee bid process management assignments for procurement of power by distribution licensees.
* Lead analysis of policy and regulatory developments and assess their implications on client businesses, providing actionable recommendations.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients in the Southern region, leading discussions, meetings, and stakeholder engagements.
* Mentor and guide team members, review their work, and ensure consistency, accuracy, and quality in deliverables.
* Coordinate closely with internal teams to manage project execution, resolve issues, and maintain delivery schedules.
* Lead preparation and presentation of concept notes, thought leadership papers, and client presentations for senior management forums.
* Represent the organization in client meetings, conferences, workshops, and industry events across the Southern region, as required.
* Foster a collaborative, high-ownership team culture aligned with organizational goals.

**D. Required skill set:**

* Proven track record in business development, client acquisition, and revenue growth within a consulting or advisory environment, ideally within the Southern region market.
* Demonstrated ability to sell a portfolio of consulting solutions to new and existing clients, and to build long-term senior client relationships.
* Proven ability to lead multiple consulting engagements and manage complex assignments in a fast-paced consulting environment.
* Strong understanding of the power sector value chain, with experience in at least two of the following areas — Power Markets, Power Distribution or Renewables— and the ability to translate this expertise into new business opportunities for the firm.
* Demonstrated experience working with a wide range of stakeholders, including Private, State, and Central Generators, Electricity Regulatory Commissions, Government bodies, and Power Utilities.
* Good understanding of the power sector landscape, including emerging policies and regulations, and their implications for clients.
* Excellent leadership, mentoring, and team management capabilities, with experience managing and growing consulting teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts and thought leadership clearly to senior stakeholders.
* High level of analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making ability.
* Proven ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams.
* Proficiency in data analysis, reporting, and presentation tools (PowerPoint, Excel, etc.).
* Strong research orientation with the ability to translate insights into compelling client-facing and thought leadership content.

**E. Education and Experience**

* B.E/B. Tech/ B. Com with MBA or Ph.D. in relevant field.
* Minimum 15 years of experience in at-least two of the following areas- Power Markets, Power Distribution and Renewable.
* Preference will be given to candidates having current working experience in Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and/or other Southern States.
* Energy/Power consultancy experience will be preferred.

**F. Location**

* We offer a motivation based and competitive reward package.

* Authoring articles and white papers
* Business / technology innovation experience with emerging tech solutions leveraging power of combinatorial technologies AI/ML, Data Automation, Blockchain, IoT, etc

* Demonstrated capability to drive sales and bring a network of client relationships to the firm
* Relevant industry certification (e.g., TOGAF Biz Architect, Business Process Framework (eTOM Practitioner of TMForum), AWS Cloud Certified etc.).

title: Marketing Automation Manager
description:
**About IDP**
IDP is the global leader in international education services, delivering global success to students, test takers and our partners, through trusted human relationships, digital technology and customer research. An Australian-listed company, we operate in more than 50 countries around the world.
  
  
Our team is comprised of over 7,000 people of various nationalities, ages and cultural backgrounds. Proudly customer-first, our expert people are powered by global technology. Together, we offer unmatched services, helping local dreams become realities, all over the world.
  
  
Learn more at www.careers.idp.com
  
  
****Role purpose****
To lead the strategy, design, and delivery of marketing automation campaigns and customer journeys that drive market share, lead conversion, customer engagement, and retention for IELTS and Student Placement across Australia and New Zealand. The role focuses on leveraging Marketo and other marketing technologies to deliver personalized, data-driven, cross-channel communications and continuously improve campaign performance and customer experience.
  
  
****Key accountabilities****

* Marketing Automation Strategy: Develop and manage the marketing automation roadmap aligned with business and marketing priorities, establishing scalable frameworks and best practices.
* Customer Journey Design: Map and optimize end-to-end customer journeys using customer segmentation, behavioral triggers, lifecycle stages, and automated workflows.
* Campaign Planning and Execution: Lead the end-to-end setup, testing, execution, and optimization of campaigns across email, SMS, WhatsApp, push notifications, and in-app messaging.
* Personalization and Optimization: Implement personalized content, A/B testing, and campaign optimization strategies to improve engagement, conversion, and customer experience.
* Marketing Platforms and Integration: Manage Marketo and connected marketing technologies, ensuring effective integration with CRM systems, lead forms, and other customer touchpoints.
* Performance Reporting and Analytics: Monitor campaign KPIs, engagement, conversion rates, and ROI; generate actionable insights and recommendations to improve performance.
* Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with regional and global marketing teams, technology teams, customer support, external vendors, and agencies to deliver integrated marketing initiatives.
* Brand and Compliance Management: Ensure all marketing communications align with IDP and IELTS brand guidelines and comply with applicable legislation and organizational quality standards.

**Required Experience**

* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent qualification.
* Relevant Experience: Approximately 3 years of experience in marketing automation, CRM, or lifecycle marketing.
* Marketing Automation Tools: Hands-on experience with Marketo is a requirement, including the implementation of complex email campaigns, automated workflows, and customer nurture journeys.
* Customer Journey Management: Strong understanding of customer segmentation, lead nurturing, lifecycle marketing, triggers, and automation logic.
* Digital Marketing Knowledge: Exposure to broader digital marketing disciplines, including SEO, SEM, UX, and programmatic advertising.
* CRM and Integrations: Understanding of CRM integration, data flows, lead management processes, and marketing technology platforms.
* Campaign Analytics: Experience measuring and optimizing campaign performance using tools such as Marketo, GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Data Studio.
* Testing and Optimization: Knowledge of A/B and multivariate testing, test planning, campaign reporting, and performance assessment.
* Content and Communication: Skills in copywriting, email design best practices, and basic creative asset production using tools such as Canva.
* Stakeholder Management: Ability to translate technical requirements into business solutions and collaborate effectively with marketing, technology, regional teams, and external partners.
* Additional Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, strong organizational and prioritization skills, attention to detail, and knowledge of digital marketing trends. Familiarity with ADMA policies and guidelines is desirable.

title: B2B Business Development Executive - Influencer Marketing.
description:
**Senior Sales & Partnerships Executive – Creator Marketing &**
**Digital Solutions**

**Department:**

Partnerships

**Location:**

Remote

**Employment Type:**

Full-time

**About QYUBIC**

QYUBIC is a performance marketing ecosystem company helping brands reach customers and drive measurable business results across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and the wider MENA region.

Our solutions include creator marketing, affiliate partnerships, coupons and savings, rewards, and performance marketing.

**QYUBIC X (QX)**

is our creator marketing business, helping brands turn creator partnerships into measurable business growth.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a commercially driven sales professional to acquire new clients and grow QYUBIC X.

Working directly with the Head of Partnerships, you’ll identify prospects, engage decision-makers, pitch solutions, negotiate commercial terms, and close new partnerships. You’ll have ownership of new business development and the opportunity to contribute directly to the growth of our creator marketing business.

Experience in influencer marketing is an advantage, but not essential. We welcome proven B2B sales professionals from digital advertising, media, marketing agencies, affiliate marketing, adtech, SaaS, and other B2B services.

**The priority is your ability to win business, demonstrate commercial results and build lasting client relationships.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Generate new business:**

  Identify target brands, engage decision-makers and develop opportunities through outbound outreach, networking and referrals.
* **Pitch solutions:**

  Understand client objectives and present relevant QYUBIC X offerings, including paid creator campaigns, product-exchange collaborations and performance-led partnerships.
* **Develop proposals and negotiate:**

  Recommend suitable solutions, prepare commercial proposals and negotiate pricing, deliverables and partnership terms.
* **Close deals:**

  Own opportunities from initial prospecting through negotiation and signed agreement, taking responsibility for commercial outcomes.
* **Grow client relationships:**

  Identify repeat business, expand partnerships and develop long-term accounts.

* Experience selling services or solutions to businesses, brands or agencies.
* Strong prospecting, presentation, communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage a sales pipeline, work towards targets and operate independently in a remote environment.
* Excellent English communication skills.

* Influencer marketing solutions selling, creator partnerships or talent agencies
* Digital advertising, media sales or marketing agencies
* Affiliate marketing, partnerships or performance marketing
* Adtech, martech, SaaS or other B2B services
* Sponsorships, brand partnerships or promotional solutions

title: Senior Technical Marketing Specialist
description:
**Senior Technical**
**Marketing Specialist**
**Ready to lead digital marketing for global scientific journals and conferences?**
**About Our Team**
Our STMJ (Science, Technology, and Medical Journals) team publishes high-quality, peer-reviewed research that drives progress across scientific and medical disciplines. We collaborate closely with authors, editors, reviewers, and societies to ensure the integrity and impact of the published work. Through innovation in editorial workflows and publishing technology, we help global research communities discover, evaluate, and disseminate knowledge that advances science and improves lives.
  
  
**About The Role**
To support the STM Journals division by successful management and delivery of all aspects of marketing for the Conference and journal product lines. Provision of support to e-Marketing team as needed to ensure standards, targets are met and deadlines are achieved.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Monitor daily workloads, support the team in meeting SLAs, resolve IT or technical issues quickly, and share professional expertise.
* Plan, manage, and deliver e-marketing activities for Elsevier STM Journals and Conferences within agreed quality standards and SLAs.
* Act as a super user for relevant marketing tools and systems, and provide feedback on developments and functionality to Marketing Communications Managers and Publishing.
* Improve product webpages and websites, maintain the online presence, and manage escalations or sensitive stakeholder issues in a timely manner.
* Create and manage email marketing collateral, advise on requirements gathering, release testing, technical feasibility, and project planning, and analyse channels to increase conversions and actions.
* Lead or support key MCRED projects, identify team improvement and skill-development needs, and advise business contacts on online marketing best practices.
* Evaluate emerging marketing technologies, trends, communication techniques, and media regulations, while periodically optimising workflows to improve efficiency and quality.

**Requirements**

* Integrity and honesty: Follow rules and commitments, make ethical decisions, earn trust, and treat others fairly and respectfully.
* Relationship building and teamwork: Establish rapport, collaborate effectively within and across teams, adapt interactions to others, minimise conflict, and build mutually beneficial relationships.
* Communication: Provide clear instructions and direction, listen actively, ask effective questions, and explain business context so others understand situations and expectations.
* Results orientation: Build commitment to individual and team objectives, create urgency around goals, and follow through on commitments to ensure successful completion.
* Technical expertise and problem-solving: Apply strong professional knowledge in the wider business context, provide dependable advice, contribute meaningfully to the team, and resolve core or complex issues quickly with others.
* Digital and technical capabilities: Demonstrate strong knowledge of HTML, CSS data-driven web solutions, large-data handling, workflow automation, content management systems, web and email analytics, Excel, and tools such as Dreamweaver, Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign. Hands on knowledge of AI tools to improve workflows and add value.
* Marketing and delivery skills: Bring online marketing and web-publishing expertise, awareness of browsers and platforms, excellent written and verbal English, workload prioritization, deadline management, project management, the ability to work under pressure, and the ability to coach non-technical colleagues.
* Education and experience: Hold a university degree, preferably an MBA in Marketing, with 3–4 years of relevant experience, ideally in a digital marketing role.

**Work in a way that works for you**
We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.
  
  

* Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

**Working for you**
**Benefits**
We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
  
  

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work-related challenges.
* Medical Screening: Your well-being is a top priority.
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
* Long-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
* Free Transport pick up and drop from the home -office - home (applies in Chennai)

**About The Business**
A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.
  
  
**We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.**

title: Brand Manager - EV
description:
**Job Purpose**

The role of Brand Manager - EV will work towards strategizing, ideation, conceptualization, development and execution of new brand initiatives in the EV domain across markets, geographies and regions. The ideal incumbent will have a strong understanding of the EV industry, brand building, 360 media initiatives, collaborations and conceptualization of new & alternate initiatives to enable the brand to position itself in the EV domain.

Brand Manager - EV will be responsible for end to end brand management for our new offerings in the EV domain - creating sustainable engagement with Royal Enfield (RE) consumer, focussing on regional penetration and demand creation, brand plan formulation, brand positioning and increasing aspiration levels with respect to the brand, launch planning, readiness and execution in all geographies, building brand awareness and driving business funnel.

The position will report to the EV Brand Lead and work closely with the EV Function, Global Brand

(Digital, Creative Strategy, PR), Product Strategy team, Business Heads, EV Business Development and marketing leads across geographies to accomplish the role's purpose.

**Position Overview**

Location: Chennai

Position Title: Deputy Manager

Reports to: EV Brand Lead

Function: EV Brand

**What you’ll do:**

* Create and execute an annual brand plan to build brand awareness & aspiration through the brand’s positioning in priority markets.
* Strategize, plan and lead the execution of brand portfolio strategy; develop relevant campaigns to improve brand health, awareness, enquiries and retail sales
* Partner with external execution partners for onground roll out of finalized initiatives - Evaluation &mfinalization of communication strategy, collaborate with vendors / partners for development of impactful communication for creating impactful communication campaigns
* Ensure cost effectiveness by leading negotiations, managing logistics, overseeing production, ensuring legal approvals and ensuring due research at various stages (Pre & Post) for generating effective consumer market insights
* Direct & Monitor the marketing initiatives for an impactful execution - Briefing & reviewing media plans, Providing release material to media, lead the GTM strategy and roll out plans, work with PR team to drive brand initiatives, analyzing impact on brand, retails & enquiries and providing update, reports on campaigns and escalate issues when necessary
* Enhance Consumer engagement to strengthen brand health - Conceptualization & Development of the consumer engagement plans, liaising with activation team for agency & cost finalization, aligning key stakeholders – senior , legal ,media & sales teams; rolling out & monitoring of the campaign in the field
* Liaison with CFTs for brand life cycle management - Contribute towards Brand extension strategy, lead on finalization of brand names, Legal Approval for brand extensions and names, Internal Alignment
* Communication & advertising Initiatives: Leverage opportunities such as festivals, Sports, results, Service and other avenues - Brief preparation along with relevant stakeholders / agreement on schedule, Vetting briefs, Review output from agencies, ensure internal approvals, release etc.
* Contribute towards ensuring positive P&L metrics for the brand, ensure retail volume and market share as per agreed SBP
* Identifying or development of brand activations & partnerships, Partake in regional marketing conversation to oversee brand initiatives
* Liaison with content & digital team to develop and disseminate communication for various initiative

**What you'll bring:**

Experience:

* 5 years of experience in building brands which create aspiration
* Possessing clear brand sensibility and creative abilities
* Prior experience of working in the EV industry will be an added advantage
* Passion for motorcycling and experience of working with Lifestyle/youth brands would be an advantage

**Qualification:**
Bachelor's Degree (Full Time) - Specialization in Marketing, Advertising, Communications or related streams

**Why work with us?**

We are a global leader in middleweight motorcycles (250-750cc), operating in 80 countries. Royal Enfield’s unique approach to forging our path has led to consistent growth and profitability. Emphasizing our values and brand essence, we strive to transform into a premium experiential brand. By embracing diversity and new ideas from various industries and regions, we are expanding our team for a broader perspective on global markets.

**Ready to join us?**

Apply via our website today. Join our trailblazing team and be a part of our legacy! “So why wait? Join us and experience the freedom of embracing the road, riding with pure motorcycling passion.”

title: Account Director
description:
**Role Purpose**

To lead client relationships, drive strategic thinking and deliver integrated marketing and communication solutions across traditional and digital channels. The Account Director is responsible for understanding clients’ business objectives, translating them into effective brand and marketing strategies, ensuring excellent execution, and identifying opportunities to grow existing accounts.

The role requires a strong understanding of digital marketing, social media, content, performance marketing and data-led communication, alongside conventional advertising and brand building.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Client Relationship Management**

- Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key client stakeholders.

- Develop a thorough understanding of clients’ businesses, categories, consumers, competition and marketing objectives.

- Act as the senior point of contact for assigned accounts and proactively address client needs.

- Build client confidence through strategic inputs, proactive recommendations and consistent delivery.

**2. Brand Strategy and Integrated Planning**

- Translate business and marketing objectives into effective brand and communication strategies.

- Lead the development of annual brand plans, campaign briefs and integrated communication roadmaps.

- Integrate traditional advertising, digital marketing, social media, content and other relevant channels into cohesive brand solutions.

- Bring consumer insights, category intelligence, cultural trends and competitive analysis into strategic recommendations.

- Identify opportunities for brands to strengthen their positioning, relevance and engagement across consumer touchpoints.

**3. Digital Marketing and Social Media**

- Develop a strong understanding of digital ecosystems and their role in achieving brand and business objectives.

- Lead client discussions on digital strategy, social media, content planning, audience engagement and online brand building.

- Guide the development of digital-first campaigns, platform-specific content and always-on communication plans.

- Stay abreast of emerging platforms, digital trends, consumer behaviour and marketing technologies, including AI-led opportunities.

- Ensure digital initiatives are integrated with the overall brand strategy rather than operating as disconnected activities.

**4. Campaign Management and Execution**

title: City Lead
description:
We operate through two key sales channels — Spinny Retail and Spinny Partners (B2B Auction platform).

●
**Retail:**
We purchase used cars on our inventory, refurbish them at our owned workshops, and sell them through our retail outlets in Hub and Park formats

●
**Auction:**
We enable digital auctions for used car dealers based on in-house inspection reports. Prices are offered to sellers only after a confirmed dealer bid, ensuring minimal inventory risk.

The Supply vertical (car procurement) is common to both channels. Every incoming car runs through the Auction platform for the best price discovery, leveraging our network of 10,000+ channel partners, including Spinny Retail.

**SUPPLY CHANNELS**

We operate two primary procurement channels:

3. Inspection Ops: A fleet of technical evaluators who work in defined slots, moving from one scheduled evaluation to another. Each evaluator starts and ends their day from their home location 4. Closure: A tele-sales team responsible for price negotiation with sellers. They attempt to bridge price gaps by collaborating with sales teams, and schedule delivery once the price is agreed

5. Delivery Ops: A team of drivers and documentation agents who manage the final pickup, verify documentation, and trigger payment upon approval.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

● Oversee evaluation, delivery, documentation, and logistics for the G1 channel

**2. Scale G3 Channel (B2B Supply):**

● Own the end-to-end funnel for the G3 channel — from lead generation to final delivery and price negotiations

● Lead growth and P&L for the G3 vertical in the respective geography

● Develop and execute strategies to expand partnerships with new car dealerships to maximise procurements from the exchange enquiries

● Good stakeholder management skills.

● Excellent written, communication, research, and analytical skills.

● Previous team management/leadership ability to lead teams of at least 15-20 members.

This internship is for job seekers who have completed their studies and are ready to work full-time. It is not open to students. Interns who perform well will be offered a full-time role with us.

This is not a desk internship with a fixed routine. You will work directly with the founder, see how a business is built from the ground up, and take on real responsibility from your first week. If you want exposure, learning, and hands-on experience more than anything else, read on.

**What you will do**

**Sales**

• Find and reach out to potential customers by phone, WhatsApp, and in-person visits.

• Follow up on leads, explain our products, and close orders.

• Build and maintain relationships with customers, dealers and partners.

**Marketing**

• Plan and post content on our social media channels.

• Support online campaigns, promotions and local marketing activities.

• Collect customer feedback and market insights from the field.

**Supporting tasks**

• Coordinate orders, deliveries and vendors.

• Keep sales, stock and customer records up to date in Excel or Google Sheets.

• Prepare simple reports and presentations for the founder.

• Take on whatever the business needs that week; in a startup, everyone does a bit of everything.

**Who we are looking for**

**Must have**

• Real passion and enthusiasm for business: you enjoy selling, talking to people and figuring out how things work.

• Fluent in Tamil and English (spoken).

• Basic computer skills: Excel, Word and PowerPoint.

• Your own laptop, mobile phone, and two-wheeler (with a valid driving licence).

• Willing to travel for customer visits, market visits, and events.

**Good to have**

• Hindi.

• Any attempt at entrepreneurship: a small business, freelancing, reselling, or running a social media channel or page. Tell us about it, even if it didn't work out.

• Any sales, marketing or customer-facing experience, from a previous job, a business, or freelance work.

• Living in or near Vandalur, Chennai.

**Internship Details**

* Stipend (during internship): ₹5,000 per month
* Duration: 1 Month
* After the internship: Full-time role for selected interns
* Working days: 4 days a week: 3 weekdays + 1 weekend day
* Work mode: Hybrid; come to the office when required
* Location: Office near Vandalur, Chennai, plus field travel
* You bring: Your own laptop, mobile phone, and two-wheeler

**Please read before applying**

**If your priority is salary and convenience, this internship is not for you, and we request you not to apply.**

We are looking for someone whose first priority is exposure, learning, and experience. You will learn how a business is built from scratch, through sales and marketing, faster than in most jobs. In return, we expect ownership, flexibility, and the drive to make things happen. Interns who show this will continue with us full-time.

About the Role

We are looking for a

.

The ideal candidate should be someone who can come up with ideas, write the copy, create basic creatives/videos/reels, identify trends and execute content without constantly depending on a designer, content writer or video editor.

* Captions and copy
* Hooks and CTAs

* Support employer branding and recruitment marketing initiatives.
* Plan and execute social media campaigns for company events, announcements, product launches and other initiatives.

Candidate Requirements

* **2–3 years of hands-on experience**
  in Social Media Management, Social Media Strategy or Digital Marketing.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube and other relevant platforms.
* **Strong content creation skills — the candidate must be able to create content independently.**
* Good knowledge of Canva and basic video editing tools such as CapCut or similar.
* Ability to write engaging captions, hooks, headlines and CTAs.
* Strong creative thinking and storytelling ability.
* Good understanding of social media analytics and performance metrics.
* Ability to identify trends and turn them into relevant content quickly.
* Strong communication and copywriting skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of the complete social media function.
* Ability to manage multiple content requirements and meet deadlines.

Must-Have

**This is a hands-on role. Candidates should be comfortable creating content themselves rather than only planning or delegating content creation.**

The candidate should be able to:

**Think → Ideate → Create → Edit → Publish → Analyse → Improve**

Candidates who only have experience in
**content planning/coordination**
and depend entirely on designers or content writers for execution may not be suitable for this role.

Good to Have

* Experience in B2B / IT / Technology / Startup environments.
* Experience managing LinkedIn pages and employer branding.
* Basic understanding of Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads.
* Experience creating Reels/short-form videos.
* Experience using AI tools for content creation.

* Content quality and consistency
* Reels/video performance
* Lead generation and conversions
* Employer brand visibility
* Campaign performance
* Ability to consistently produce and publish content independently

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is
**not just a Social Media Manager, but a creator + strategist**
.

Someone who can take a requirement like
*“We need to promote this event”*
and independently turn it into:

**Idea → Content Concept → Copy → Creative/Video → Caption → Publishing → Performance Analysis.**

You should be comfortable getting your hands dirty and creating the content yourself —
**not waiting for someone else to create it for you.**
